name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.lineHom_linear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lineHom_linear {U V : Set T} {hU : IsUpperSet U}
    {hV : IsUpperSet V} (hUV : U ⊆ V) :
    (lineHom k T (hU := hU) (hV := hV) hUV).linear =
      (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.lineHom_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hlinear := congrArg Hom.linear hzero
  have hidzero : (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k) = 0 := by
    simpa using hlinear
  have happ := LinearMap.congr_fun hidzero (1 : k)
  have hone : (1 : k) = 0 := by simpa using happ
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) hone

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.lineHom_not_isIso
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hIso
  let f := lineHom k T (hU := hU) (hV := hV) hUV.1
  letI : IsIso f := hIso
  obtain ⟨t, htV, htU⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset hUV
  have hinv_mem : (inv f).linear (1 : k) ∈
      (line k T U hU).subspace t := by
    apply (inv f).map_subspace
    change (1 : k) ∈ if t ∈ V then ⊤ else ⊥
    rw [if_pos htV]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  have hinv_zero : (inv f).linear (1 : k) = 0 := by
    change (inv f).linear (1 : k) ∈ if t ∈ U then ⊤ else ⊥ at hinv_mem
    rw [if_neg htU] at hinv_mem
    simpa using hinv_mem
  have hone : (1 : k) = 0 := by
    have hcomp : inv f ≫ f = 𝟙 (line k T V hV) := by
      simpa using (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc f (𝟙 _))
    have happ : f.linear ((inv f).linear (1 : k)) = 1 := by
      have h := congrArg
        (fun g : line k T V hV ⟶ line k T V hV ↦ g.linear (1 : k)) hcomp
      exact h
    calc
      (1 : k) = f.linear ((inv f).linear 1) := happ.symm
      _ = f.linear 0 := by rw [hinv_zero]
      _ = 0 := LinearMap.map_zero f.linear
  exact one_ne_zero hone

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.line_isSchur
statement:
theorem line_isSchur (U : Set T) (hU : IsUpperSet U) :
    IsSchur k T (line k T U hU)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero⟩
  · intro f
    refine ⟨f.linear 1, ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    calc
      f.linear x = f.linear (x • (1 : k)) := by simp
      _ = x • f.linear 1 := by rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
      _ = (f.linear 1) • (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k) x := by
        simp [mul_comm]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.reverseIndex_anti
statement:
theorem reverseIndex_anti {s t : T} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    reverseIndex T t ≤ reverseIndex T s
proof:
:= by
  have hdual : OrderDual.toDual t ≤ OrderDual.toDual s := hst
  have hext : toLinearExtension (OrderDual.toDual t) ≤
      toLinearExtension (OrderDual.toDual s) :=
    (toLinearExtension : OrderDual T →o ReverseExtension T).monotone hdual
  exact (reverseOrderIso T).symm.monotone hext

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportAt_isUpperSet
statement:
theorem supportAt_isUpperSet (j : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1)) :
    IsUpperSet (supportAt T j)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst hs
  have hindex : reverseIndex T t ≤ reverseIndex T s :=
    reverseIndex_anti T hst
  change (reverseIndex T s).val < j.val at hs
  have hindex_val : (reverseIndex T t).val ≤ (reverseIndex T s).val := hindex
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hindex_val hs

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportAt_mono
statement:
theorem supportAt_mono {i j : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1)} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    supportAt T i ⊆ supportAt T j
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  change (reverseIndex T t).val < i.val at ht
  have hij_val : i.val ≤ j.val := hij
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht hij_val

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.reverseIndex_reverseElement
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverseIndex_reverseElement (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    reverseIndex T (reverseElement T j) = j
proof:
:= by
  exact (reverseOrderIso T).symm_apply_apply j

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.ReverseEnumeration.index_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem index_equiv (R : ReverseEnumeration T) (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    index T R (R.equiv j) = j
proof:
:=
  R.equiv.symm_apply_apply j

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.ReverseEnumeration.index_injective
statement:
theorem index_injective (R : ReverseEnumeration T) :
    Function.Injective (index T R)
proof:
:=
  R.equiv.symm.injective

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportAt_zero
statement: theorem supportAt_zero : supportAt T 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp [supportAt]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportAt_last
statement: theorem supportAt_last : supportAt T (Fin.last (Fintype.card T)) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp [supportAt, Fin.is_lt]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportAt_strictMono
statement:
theorem supportAt_strictMono (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    supportAt T j.castSucc ⊂ supportAt T j.succ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro t ht
    exact Nat.lt_trans ht (Nat.lt_succ_self j.val)
  · intro hEq
    have hmem : reverseElement T j ∈ supportAt T j.succ := by
      simp [supportAt]
    have hnot : reverseElement T j ∉ supportAt T j.castSucc := by
      simp [supportAt]
    exact hnot (hEq hmem)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineStep_not_isIso
statement:
theorem supportLineStep_not_isIso (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    ¬ IsIso (supportLineStep k T j)
proof:
:=
  lineHom_not_isIso k T
    (hU := supportAt_isUpperSet T j.castSucc)
    (hV := supportAt_isUpperSet T j.succ)
    (supportAt_strictMono T j)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_hom_linear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supportLineChain_hom_linear :
    (supportLineChain k T).hom.linear = (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_hom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem supportLineChain_hom_ne_zero :
    (supportLineChain k T).hom ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hlinear := congrArg Hom.linear hzero
  have hidzero : (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k) = 0 := by
    simpa using hlinear
  have happ := LinearMap.congr_fun hidzero (1 : k)
  have hone : (1 : k) = 0 := by simpa using happ
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) hone

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_map_succ
statement:
theorem supportLineChain_map_succ (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    (supportLineChain k T).map'
        j.val (j.val + 1) (Nat.le_succ _) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.isLt) =
      supportLineStep k T j
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.ext
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_map_succ_not_isIso
statement:
theorem supportLineChain_map_succ_not_isIso
    (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    ¬ IsIso ((supportLineChain k T).map'
      j.val (j.val + 1) (Nat.le_succ _) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.isLt))
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportLineChain_map_succ]
  exact supportLineStep_not_isIso k T j

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_map_succ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem supportLineChain_map_succ_ne_zero
    (j : Fin (Fintype.card T)) :
    (supportLineChain k T).map'
      j.val (j.val + 1) (Nat.le_succ _) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt j.isLt) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportLineChain_map_succ]
  exact lineHom_ne_zero k T (supportAt_strictMono T j).1

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.PositiveGrading.hasNonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost
statement:
theorem PositiveGrading.hasNonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost
    {C : Type u} [Category C] [HasZeroMorphisms C]
    {P : C → Prop} {L : ℕ} (G : PositiveGrading C P L) :
    HasNonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost C P L
proof:
:= by
  intro n F hF
  have hlevel : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), i.val ≤ G.level (F.obj i) := by
    intro i
    induction i using Fin.induction with
    | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
    | succ i ih =>
        apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt ih
          (G.lt_of_nonzero_not_isIso
            (F.map' i.val (i.val + 1)
              (Nat.le_succ _) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt))
            (hF.1 i.castSucc) (hF.1 i.succ)
            (hF.2.1 i).1 (hF.2.1 i).2)
  exact le_trans (hlevel (Fin.last n)) (G.level_le _ (hF.1 (Fin.last n)))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLineChain_isNonzeroNonisomorphismChain
statement:
theorem supportLineChain_isNonzeroNonisomorphismChain :
    ∀ {P : Obj k T → Prop},
      (∀ j, P (supportLine k T j)) →
        IsNonzeroNonisomorphismChain P (supportLineChain k T)
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  constructor
  · exact hP
  constructor
  · intro j
    exact ⟨supportLineChain_map_succ_ne_zero k T j,
      supportLineChain_map_succ_not_isIso k T j⟩
  · exact supportLineChain_hom_ne_zero k T

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_le_of_nonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost
proof:
:=
  hLength (Fintype.card T) (supportLineChain k T)
    (supportLineChain_isNonzeroNonisomorphismChain k T support_admissible)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_le_of_positiveGrading
proof:
:=
  card_le_of_nonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost k T support_admissible
    G.hasNonzeroNonisomorphismLengthAtMost

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_le_of_schurPositiveGrading
proof:
:=
  card_le_of_positiveGrading k T
    (fun j ↦ line_isSchur k T (supportAt T j) (supportAt_isUpperSet T j)) G

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.supportLine_level_add_index_le
statement:
theorem supportLine_level_add_index_le
    {L : ℕ}
    (G : PositiveGrading (Obj k T) (IsSchur k T) L)
    {i j : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1)} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    G.level (supportLine k T i) + j.val ≤
      G.level (supportLine k T j) + i.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
  rcases j with ⟨j, hj⟩
  change i ≤ j at hij
  simp only
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ j _ ih =>
      specialize ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hj)
      let r : Fin (Fintype.card T) := ⟨j, by omega⟩
      have hstep :
          G.level (supportLine k T r.castSucc) <
            G.level (supportLine k T r.succ) :=
        G.lt_of_nonzero_not_isIso (supportLineStep k T r)
          (line_isSchur k T (supportAt T r.castSucc)
            (supportAt_isUpperSet T r.castSucc))
          (line_isSchur k T (supportAt T r.succ)
            (supportAt_isUpperSet T r.succ))
          (lineHom_ne_zero k T (supportAt_strictMono T r).1)
          (supportLineStep_not_isIso k T r)
      change G.level (supportLine k T ⟨j, by omega⟩) <
        G.level (supportLine k T ⟨j + 1, hj⟩) at hstep
      omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_add_one_le_of_schurDetour
statement:
theorem card_add_one_le_of_schurDetour
    {L q : ℕ}
    (G : PositiveGrading (Obj k T) (IsSchur k T) L)
    {hq : q + 2 < Fintype.card T} (D : SchurDetour k T q hq) :
    Fintype.card T + 1 ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  let iq1 : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1) :=
    ⟨q + 1, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (by omega)⟩
  let iq2 : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1) :=
    ⟨q + 2, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr (by omega)⟩
  let ilast : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1) := Fin.last (Fintype.card T)
  have hprefix := supportLine_level_add_index_le k T G
    (i := (0 : Fin (Fintype.card T + 1))) (j := iq1) (Fin.zero_le _)
  have hin : G.level (supportLine k T iq1) < G.level D.middle :=
    G.lt_of_nonzero_not_isIso D.inMap
      (line_isSchur k T (supportAt T iq1) (supportAt_isUpperSet T iq1))
      D.middle_schur D.inMap_ne_zero D.inMap_not_isIso
  have hout : G.level D.middle < G.level (supportLine k T iq2) :=
    G.lt_of_nonzero_not_isIso D.outMap D.middle_schur
      (line_isSchur k T (supportAt T iq2) (supportAt_isUpperSet T iq2))
      D.outMap_ne_zero D.outMap_not_isIso
  change G.level (supportLine k T iq1) < G.level D.middle at hin
  change G.level D.middle < G.level (supportLine k T iq2) at hout
  have hsuffix := supportLine_level_add_index_le k T G
    (i := iq2) (j := ilast) (by
      change q + 2 ≤ Fintype.card T
      exact Nat.le_of_lt hq)
  have htop := G.level_le (supportLine k T ilast)
    (line_isSchur k T (supportAt T ilast) (supportAt_isUpperSet T ilast))
  have hprefix' : q + 1 ≤ G.level (supportLine k T iq1) := by
    dsimp [iq1] at hprefix ⊢
    omega
  have hdetour : G.level (supportLine k T iq1) + 2 ≤
      G.level (supportLine k T iq2) := by
    omega
  have hsuffix' : G.level (supportLine k T iq2) + Fintype.card T ≤
      G.level (supportLine k T ilast) + (q + 2) := by
    change G.level (supportLine k T iq2) + Fintype.card T ≤
      G.level (supportLine k T ilast) + (q + 2) at hsuffix
    exact hsuffix
  change G.level (supportLine k T ilast) ≤ L at htop
  dsimp [iq1, iq2, ilast] at hprefix' hdetour hsuffix' htop
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.height_eq_zero
statement:
theorem height_eq_zero (x : V) (hx : ¬ ∃ y, E y x) :
    height rank E hE x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [height]
  simp only [dif_neg hx]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.height_arrow
statement:
theorem height_arrow
    (hmesh : ∀ x, (∀ a b, E a x → E b x → a = b) ∨
      ∃ t, ∀ y, E y x → E t y) :
    ∀ x y, E x y → height rank E hE y = height rank E hE x + 1
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ y, ∀ x, E x y → height rank E hE y = height rank E hE x + 1 := by
    intro y
    induction y using (measure rank).wf.induction with
    | h y ih =>
      intro x hxy
      have hy : ∃ a, E a y := ⟨x, hxy⟩
      have hp := hy.choose_spec
      have heq : height rank E hE hy.choose = height rank E hE x := by
        rcases hmesh y with hb | ⟨t, ht⟩
        · rw [hb hy.choose x hp hxy]
        · have ha := ih hy.choose (hE _ _ hp) t (ht _ hp)
          have hx := ih x (hE _ _ hxy) t (ht _ hxy)
          exact ha.trans hx.symm
      rw [height, dif_pos hy, heq]
  exact fun x y ↦ aux y x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.height_mesh
statement:
theorem height_mesh
    (hmesh : ∀ x, (∀ a b, E a x → E b x → a = b) ∨
      ∃ t, ∀ y, E y x → E t y)
    (t x : V) (hx : ∃ y, E y x)
    (ht : ∀ y, E y x → E t y) :
    height rank E hE x = height rank E hE t + 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  rw [height_arrow rank E hE hmesh y x hy,
    height_arrow rank E hE hmesh t y (ht y hy)]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.height_path
statement:
theorem height_path [Quiver V]
    (hmesh : ∀ x, (∀ a b, E a x → E b x → a = b) ∨
      ∃ t, ∀ y, E y x → E t y)
    (hedge : ∀ {x y : V}, (x ⟶ y) → E x y)
    {x y : V} (p : Quiver.Path x y) :
    height rank E hE y = height rank E hE x + p.length
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons y z p e ih =>
    rw [height_arrow rank E hE hmesh y z (hedge e), ih]
    simp only [Quiver.Path.length_cons]
    omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.path_length_eq
statement:
theorem path_length_eq [Quiver V]
    (hmesh : ∀ x, (∀ a b, E a x → E b x → a = b) ∨
      ∃ t, ∀ y, E y x → E t y)
    (hedge : ∀ {x y : V}, (x ⟶ y) → E x y)
    {x y : V} (p q : Quiver.Path x y) : p.length = q.length
proof:
:= by
  have hp := height_path rank E hE hmesh hedge p
  have hq := height_path rank E hE hmesh hedge q
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.AdaptedBasis.coordinateProjection_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateProjection_self {ι : Type v} (b : Basis ι k V) (i : ι) :
    coordinateProjection b i (b i) = b i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateProjection, Basis.coord_apply]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.AdaptedBasis.coordinateProjection_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateProjection_of_ne {ι : Type v} (b : Basis ι k V)
    {i j : ι} (hji : j ≠ i) :
    coordinateProjection b i (b j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateProjection, Basis.coord_apply, hji]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.AdaptedBasis.coordinateProjection_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem coordinateProjection_mem_of_mem {ι : Type v} (b : Basis ι k V)
    {U : Submodule k V} (hU : AdaptsSubmodule b U) (i : ι)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    coordinateProjection b i x ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases hU with ⟨S, rfl⟩
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simpa using
          (Submodule.subset_span (R := k)
            (show b i ∈ b '' S from ⟨i, hj, rfl⟩))
      · simp [coordinateProjection_of_ne b hji]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => simpa using Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy
  | smul c x hx ih => simpa using Submodule.smul_mem _ c ih

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.finrank_le_one_of_isSchur_of_hasCommonAdaptedBasis
statement:
theorem finrank_le_one_of_isSchur_of_hasCommonAdaptedBasis
    (X : Obj k T) (hschur : IsSchur k T X)
    (hadapted : HasCommonAdaptedBasis X) :
    Module.finrank k X ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hadapted with ⟨b, hb⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hrank : 2 ≤ Module.finrank k X := by omega
  let i : Fin (Module.finrank k X) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : Fin (Module.finrank k X) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hij : j ≠ i := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [i, j] at this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hschur.2 (coordinateProjectionHom X b hb i)
  have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun hc (b i)
  have hj := LinearMap.congr_fun hc (b j)
  have hc_one : c = 1 := by
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun x ↦ b.coord i x) hi
    simpa [coordinateProjectionHom, i] using hcoord.symm
  rw [hc_one] at hj
  have hzero : b j = 0 := by
    simpa [coordinateProjectionHom, hij] using hj.symm
  exact (b.ne_zero j) hzero

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_hasCommonAdaptedBasis
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_hasCommonAdaptedBasis
    (X : Obj k T) (hschur : IsSchur k T X)
    (hadapted : HasCommonAdaptedBasis X) :
    Module.finrank k X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := finrank_le_one_of_isSchur_of_hasCommonAdaptedBasis X hschur hadapted
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank k X :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr hschur.1
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.line_support_subset_of_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h₁ : f.linear (1 : k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hf
    apply Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change f.linear x = 0
    calc
      f.linear x = f.linear (x • (1 : k)) := by simp
      _ = x • f.linear (1 : k) := f.linear.map_smul x 1
      _ = 0 := by rw [hz, smul_zero]
  intro t ht
  by_contra hn
  have hm := f.map_subspace t (1 : k) (by change (1 : k) ∈ if t ∈ U then ⊤ else ⊥; simp [ht])
  rw [line_subspace_of_not_mem k T V hV t hn] at hm
  exact h₁ (by simpa using hm)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.lineIso_hom_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := e.hom_inv_id
  rw [hz, zero_comp] at h
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun f : line k T U hU ⟶ line k T U hU ↦ f.linear (1 : k)) h
  exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : k) ≠ 1) (by simpa using h₁)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.line_support_eq_of_iso
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (line_support_subset_of_nonzero e.hom (lineIso_hom_ne_zero e))
    (line_support_subset_of_nonzero e.inv (lineIso_hom_ne_zero e.symm))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.line_level_eq_card_of_sharp_grading
statement:
theorem line_level_eq_card_of_sharp_grading
    {L : ℕ} (G : PositiveGrading (Obj k T) (IsSchur k T) L)
    (hL : L ≤ Fintype.card T) (U : Finset T) (hU : IsUpperSet (U : Set T)) :
    G.level (line k T (U : Set T) hU) = U.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let height : Finset T → ℕ := fun V ↦
    if hV : IsUpperSet (V : Set T) then G.level (line k T (V : Set T) hV) else 0
  have heval : ∀ (V : Finset T) (hV : IsUpperSet (V : Set T)),
      height V = G.level (line k T (V : Set T) hV) := by
    intro V hV
    exact dif_pos hV
  have hstep : ∀ V W : Finset T, IsUpperSet (V : Set T) → IsUpperSet (W : Set T) →
      V ⊂ W → height V < height W := by
    intro V W hV hW hVW
    rw [heval V hV, heval W hW]
    have hset : (V : Set T) ⊂ (W : Set T) := by exact_mod_cast hVW
    exact G.lt_of_nonzero_not_isIso (lineHom k T hset.1)
      (line_isSchur k T _ hV) (line_isSchur k T _ hW)
      (lineHom_ne_zero k T hset.1) (lineHom_not_isIso k T hset)
  have htop : IsUpperSet ((Finset.univ : Finset T) : Set T) := by simp [IsUpperSet]
  have hbound : height Finset.univ ≤ Fintype.card T := by
    rw [heval Finset.univ htop]
    exact (G.level_le _ (line_isSchur k T _ htop)).trans hL
  rw [← heval U hU]
  exact UpperSetHeight.height_eq_card height hstep hbound U hU

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_linear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundaryCoverMap_linear (Y : Obj k T) :
    (boundaryCoverMap Y).linear = boundaryCoverLinear Y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_surjective
statement:
theorem boundaryCoverMap_surjective (Y : Obj k T) :
    Function.Surjective (boundaryCoverMap Y).linear
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨(y, 0), ?_⟩
  change y + ∑ _t : T, (0 : Y) = y
  simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_epi
statement: theorem boundaryCoverMap_epi (Y : Obj k T) : Epi (boundaryCoverMap Y)
proof:
:=
  epi_of_linear_surjective (boundaryCoverMap Y)
    (boundaryCoverMap_surjective Y)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_subspace_surjective
statement:
theorem boundaryCoverMap_subspace_surjective
    (Y : Obj k T) (r : T) :
    Function.Surjective
      (((boundaryCoverMap Y).linear.domRestrict
        ((boundaryCover Y).subspace r)).codRestrict
          (Y.subspace r)
          (fun x ↦ (boundaryCoverMap Y).map_subspace r x.1 x.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y
  let coordinates : ∀ t : T, Y.subspace t := Pi.single r y
  let x : boundaryCoverCarrier Y := (0, coordinates)
  have hx : x ∈ (boundaryCover Y).subspace r := by
    constructor
    · rfl
    · intro t htr
      have hne : t ≠ r := fun h ↦ htr (h.le)
      simp [x, coordinates, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hne]
  refine ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (0 : Y) + ∑ t : T, (coordinates t : Y) = y
  rw [zero_add, Finset.sum_eq_single r]
  · simp [coordinates]
  · intro t _ htr
    simp [coordinates, Pi.single_eq_of_ne htr]
  · simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.map_boundaryCoverSubspace
statement:
theorem map_boundaryCoverSubspace (Y : Obj k T) (r : T) :
    Submodule.map (boundaryCoverMap Y).linear
        ((boundaryCover Y).subspace r) =
      Y.subspace r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (boundaryCoverMap Y).map_subspace r x hx
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := boundaryCoverMap_subspace_surjective Y r ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨x.1, x.2, congrArg Subtype.val hx⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySurjective.comp
statement:
theorem BoundarySurjective.comp
    {X Y Z : Obj k T} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hf : BoundarySurjective f) (hg : BoundarySurjective g) :
    BoundarySurjective (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hg.1.comp hf.1
  · intro r
    rw [comp_linear, Submodule.map_comp f.linear g.linear,
      hf.2 r, hg.2 r]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundarySurjective_iso_hom
statement:
theorem boundarySurjective_iso_hom {X Y : Obj k T} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    BoundarySurjective e.hom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro y
    exact ⟨e.inv.linear y, by
      have h := congrArg Hom.linear e.inv_hom_id
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun h y⟩
  · intro r
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact e.hom.map_subspace r x hx
    · intro y hy
      refine ⟨e.inv.linear y, e.inv.map_subspace r y hy, ?_⟩
      have h := congrArg Hom.linear e.inv_hom_id
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun h y

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_boundarySurjective
statement:
theorem boundaryCoverMap_boundarySurjective (Y : Obj k T) :
    BoundarySurjective (boundaryCoverMap Y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨boundaryCoverMap_surjective Y, map_boundaryCoverSubspace Y⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCover_eq_root_add_sum_points
statement:
theorem boundaryCover_eq_root_add_sum_points
    (Y : Obj k T) (x : boundaryCoverCarrier Y) :
    x = boundaryCoverRootVector Y x.1 +
      ∑ t : T, boundaryCoverPointVector Y t (x.2 t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change x = (x.1, 0) + ∑ t : T, (0, Pi.single t (x.2 t))
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.fst_sum,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.snd_sum]
    change x.2 =
      (0 : ∀ t : T, Y.subspace t) +
        ∑ t : T, Pi.single t (x.2 t)
    rw [zero_add]
    funext r
    rw [Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single r]
    · simp
    · intro t _ htr
      simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne htr.symm]
    · simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.lineMapOfVector_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lineMapOfVector_apply
    (U : Set T) (hU : IsUpperSet U) (X : Obj k T) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ r : T, r ∈ U → x ∈ X.subspace r) (a : k) :
    (lineMapOfVector U hU X x hx).linear a = a • x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.emptySupport_isUpperSet
statement: theorem emptySupport_isUpperSet : IsUpperSet (emptySupport : Set T)
proof:
:= by
  intro r _s _hrs hr
  exact False.elim hr

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.principalSupport_isUpperSet
statement:
theorem principalSupport_isUpperSet (t : T) :
    IsUpperSet (principalSupport t)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs htr
  exact htr.trans hrs

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.emptyLine_boundaryProjective
statement:
theorem emptyLine_boundaryProjective :
    BoundaryProjective
      (line k T emptySupport emptySupport_isUpperSet)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y f hf g
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf.1 (g.linear 1)
  let l : line k T emptySupport emptySupport_isUpperSet ⟶ X :=
    lineMapOfVector emptySupport emptySupport_isUpperSet X x
      (fun _r hr ↦ False.elim hr)
  refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change f.linear (a • x) = g.linear a
  rw [map_smul, hx]
  simpa using (g.linear.map_smul a (1 : k)).symm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.principalLine_boundaryProjective
statement:
theorem principalLine_boundaryProjective (t : T) :
    BoundaryProjective
      (line k T (principalSupport t) (principalSupport_isUpperSet t))
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y f hf g
  have hone : (1 : k) ∈
      (line k T (principalSupport t)
        (principalSupport_isUpperSet t)).subspace t := by
    rw [line_subspace_of_mem]
    · exact Submodule.mem_top
    · exact le_rfl
  have hgt : g.linear 1 ∈ Y.subspace t :=
    g.map_subspace t 1 hone
  have hgt' : g.linear 1 ∈
      Submodule.map f.linear (X.subspace t) := by
    rw [hf.2 t]
    exact hgt
  obtain ⟨x, hxt, hx⟩ := hgt'
  let l : line k T (principalSupport t)
      (principalSupport_isUpperSet t) ⟶ X :=
    lineMapOfVector (principalSupport t)
      (principalSupport_isUpperSet t) X x
      (fun r htr ↦ X.monotone_subspace htr hxt)
  refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change f.linear (a • x) = g.linear a
  rw [map_smul, hx]
  simpa using (g.linear.map_smul a (1 : k)).symm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.boundary_height_difference
statement:
theorem boundary_height_difference
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x}) (h : V → ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2) :
    (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1) - (∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1) =
      2 * ((Fintype.card V : ℤ) - Fintype.card {x // P x})
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (∑ x : {x // ¬ P x}, h x.1) =
      (∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, h x.1) + 2 * Fintype.card {x // ¬ P x} := by
    calc
      (∑ x : {x // ¬ P x}, h x.1) = ∑ x, (h (e x).1 + 2) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ ↦ he x)
      _ = (∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, h x.1) + 2 * Fintype.card {x // ¬ P x} := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, e.sum_comp (fun x ↦ h x.1)]
        simp [mul_comm]
  have hp := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype P h
  have hi := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype I h
  have hc := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype P (fun _ : V ↦ (1 : ℤ))
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hc
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.mem_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_base (A : Finset T) (t : T) : t ∈ base A ↔ ∃ a ∈ A, a < t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [base]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.base_isUpperSet
statement: theorem base_isUpperSet (A : Finset T) : IsUpperSet (base A : Set T)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := (mem_base A x).1 hx
  exact (mem_base A y).2 ⟨a, ha, hax.trans_le hxy⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.base_disjoint
statement:
theorem base_disjoint (A : Finset T)
    (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, a ≤ b → a = b) : Disjoint (base A) A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro b hb hbA
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := (mem_base A b).1 hb
  exact hab.ne (hA a ha b hbA hab.le)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.union_isUpperSet
statement:
theorem union_isUpperSet (A B : Finset T) (hB : B ⊆ A) :
    IsUpperSet ((base A ∪ B : Finset T) : Set T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x y hxy hx
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
  · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (base_isUpperSet A hxy hx)
  · by_cases heq : x = y
    · subst y
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hx
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ ((mem_base A y).2 ⟨x, hB hx, lt_of_le_of_ne hxy heq⟩)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.card_union
statement:
theorem card_union (A B : Finset T)
    (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, a ≤ b → a = b) (hB : B ⊆ A) :
    (base A ∪ B).card = (base A).card + B.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint ((base_disjoint A hA).mono_right hB)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.AntichainUpperCube.union_injective
statement:
theorem union_injective (A : Finset T)
    (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, a ≤ b → a = b)
    {B C : Finset T} (hB : B ⊆ A) (hC : C ⊆ A)
    (heq : base A ∪ B = base A ∪ C) : B = C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb := (base_disjoint A hA).mono_right hB
  have hc := (base_disjoint A hA).mono_right hC
  have h := congrArg (fun U : Finset T ↦ U \ base A) heq
  simpa [Finset.union_sdiff_left, Finset.sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.mpr hb.symm,
    Finset.sdiff_eq_self_iff_disjoint.mpr hc.symm] using h

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.surplus_eq_translationQuiverSurplus
statement:
theorem surplus_eq_translationQuiverSurplus
    (arrowMultiplicity : H → H → ℕ)
    (IsProjective : H → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective] :
    surplus arrowMultiplicity IsProjective =
      translationQuiverSurplus
        (vertexCount (ι := H))
        (projectiveCount IsProjective)
        (arrowCount arrowMultiplicity)
proof:
:= by
  rw [surplus, eulerMagnitude, translationQuiverSurplus,
    vertexCount_eq_projectiveCount_add_meshCount IsProjective]
  ring

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z p newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount : intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - p - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (p - 1)) :
    translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
        translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB =
      deletionCost Phi newArrows newMeshes
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationQuiverSurplus, translationQuiverSurplus, deletionCost,
    factorEulerCount]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z p newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount : intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - p - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (p - 1))
    (factorExcess_nonnegative : 0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi)
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :
    0 ≤ translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
      translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost Phi
    vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z p newArrows newMeshes vertexCount
      simpleCount ambientArrowCount quotientArrowCount factorEulerCount
      newMeshCount]
  simp only [deletionCost]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.equality_iff_zero_factorExcess_and_equal_correction
statement:
theorem equality_iff_zero_factorExcess_and_equal_correction
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ) (newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    (factorExcess_nonnegative : 0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi)
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :
    deletionCost Phi newArrows newMeshes = 0 ↔
      intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 0 ∧ newArrows = newMeshes
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deletionCost]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨hFactor, hCorrection⟩
    omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.eq_empty_or_univ_of_add_left_invariant
statement:
theorem eq_empty_or_univ_of_add_left_invariant
    {A : Type u} [AddGroup A] (H : Set A)
    (hinv : ∀ a b : A, b ∈ H ↔ a + b ∈ H) :
    H = ∅ ∨ H = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hH : H = ∅
  · exact Or.inl hH
  · right
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hH
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro a
    have hab := (hinv (a + -b) b).mp hb
    simpa [add_assoc] using hab

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.eq_empty_or_univ_of_mul_left_invariant
statement:
theorem eq_empty_or_univ_of_mul_left_invariant
    {G : Type u} [Group G] (H : Set G)
    (hinv : ∀ g h : G, h ∈ H ↔ g * h ∈ H) :
    H = ∅ ∨ H = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hH : H = ∅
  · exact Or.inl hH
  · right
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hH
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro g
    have hgh := (hinv (g * h⁻¹) h).mp hh
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hgh

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount :
      intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - projectives - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (projectives - 1))
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives))
    (realization_length_bound : projectives - 1 ≤ (L : ℤ))
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :
    0 ≤ translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
      translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB
proof:
:= by
  apply translationQuiverSurplus_difference_nonnegative Phi
    vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z projectives newArrows newMeshes vertexCount
      simpleCount ambientArrowCount quotientArrowCount factorEulerCount
      newMeshCount
  · exact matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
      Phi vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
      source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
      meshEulerTotal realization_length_bound
  · exact newMeshes_le_newArrows

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount :
      intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - projectives - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (projectives - 1))
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives))
    (realization_length_bound : projectives - 1 ≤ (L : ℤ))
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows) :
    translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
          translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB = 0 ↔
      (L : ℤ) = projectives - 1 ∧ newArrows = newMeshes
proof:
:= by
  have hFactorNonnegative : 0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi :=
    matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
      Phi vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
      source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
      meshEulerTotal realization_length_bound
  rw [translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_deletionCost Phi
    vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z projectives newArrows newMeshes vertexCount
      simpleCount ambientArrowCount quotientArrowCount factorEulerCount
      newMeshCount,
    equality_iff_zero_factorExcess_and_equal_correction Phi newArrows newMeshes
      hFactorNonnegative newMeshes_le_newArrows,
    matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
      Phi vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
      source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep meshEulerTotal]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.DirectedDeletion.finrank_eq_one_of_translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_zero_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_zero_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
    (Phi : Matrix H H ℤ)
    (vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z newArrows newMeshes : ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    {k T : Type w} [Field k] [PartialOrder T] [Fintype T]
    (projectives_eq : projectives = (Fintype.card T : ℤ) + 1)
    (grading : PosetSpace.PositiveGrading
      (PosetSpace.Obj k T) (PosetSpace.IsSchur k T) L)
    (vertexCount : vA = vB + q)
    (simpleCount : nA = nB + 1)
    (ambientArrowCount : aA = a0 + aH + z)
    (quotientArrowCount : aB = a0 + newArrows)
    (factorEulerCount :
      intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 2 * q - aH - projectives - 1)
    (newMeshCount : newMeshes = z - (projectives - 1))
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives))
    (realization_length_bound : projectives - 1 ≤ (L : ℤ))
    (newMeshes_le_newArrows : newMeshes ≤ newArrows)
    (hzero :
      translationQuiverSurplus vA nA aA -
        translationQuiverSurplus vB nB aB = 0)
    (X : PosetSpace.Obj k T) (hX : PosetSpace.IsSchur k T X) :
    Module.finrank k X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsharpZ : (L : ℤ) = projectives - 1 :=
    ((translationQuiverSurplus_difference_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
      Phi vA nA aA vB nB aB q a0 aH z newArrows newMeshes
      vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
      vertexCount simpleCount ambientArrowCount quotientArrowCount
      factorEulerCount newMeshCount source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice
      arrowStep vertexStep meshEulerTotal realization_length_bound
      newMeshes_le_newArrows).mp hzero).1
  have hsharp : L = Fintype.card T := by
    rw [projectives_eq] at hsharpZ
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : (L : ℤ) = (Fintype.card T : ℤ))
  exact PosetSpace.finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_positiveGrading_of_le_card
    k T grading (by omega) X hX

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.ext
proof:
:= by
  cases N with
  | mk Nobj Nmap =>
      cases L with
      | mk Lobj Lmap =>
          have hobj : Nobj = Lobj := funext h
          subst Lobj
          rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.isSubdiagramOf_refl
statement:
theorem isSubdiagramOf_refl (N : BoundarySubdiagram k T F) :
    N.IsSubdiagramOf N
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ le_rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.IsSubdiagramOf.trans
proof:
:=
  fun q ↦ (hNL q).trans (hLM q)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.IsSubdiagramOf.supportedAwayFromRoot
statement:
theorem IsSubdiagramOf.supportedAwayFromRoot
    {N L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F}
    (hNL : N.IsSubdiagramOf L) (hL : L.SupportedAwayFromRoot) :
    N.SupportedAwayFromRoot
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (hNL _).trans_eq hL
  · exact bot_le

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.totalFinrank_mono
statement:
theorem totalFinrank_mono [Fintype T]
    (hfinite : ∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q)))
    {N L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F} (hNL : N.IsSubdiagramOf L) :
    N.totalFinrank ≤ L.totalFinrank
proof:
:= by
  letI (q : BoundaryIndex T) : Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q)) := hfinite q
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun q _ ↦ Submodule.finrank_mono (hNL (op q))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.eq_of_isSubdiagramOf_of_totalFinrank_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_isSubdiagramOf_of_totalFinrank_eq [Fintype T]
    (hfinite : ∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q)))
    {N L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F} (hNL : N.IsSubdiagramOf L)
    (hrank : N.totalFinrank = L.totalFinrank) : N = L
proof:
:= by
  letI (q : BoundaryIndex T) : Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q)) := hfinite q
  apply ext
  intro q
  cases q using Opposite.rec with
  | _ q =>
      apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (hNL (op q))
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le fun r _ ↦
        Submodule.finrank_mono (hNL (op r))).mp hrank q (Finset.mem_univ q)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.exists_simple_subdiagram
statement:
theorem exists_simple_subdiagram [Fintype T]
    (hfinite : ∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q)))
    (N : BoundarySubdiagram k T F) (hN : ¬ N.IsZero) :
    ∃ L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
      L.IsSubdiagramOf N ∧ L.IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : ℕ → Prop := fun d ↦
    ∃ L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
      L.IsSubdiagramOf N ∧ ¬ L.IsZero ∧ L.totalFinrank = d
  have hp : ∃ d, p d :=
    ⟨N.totalFinrank, N, isSubdiagramOf_refl N, hN, rfl⟩
  let d := Nat.find hp
  obtain ⟨L, hLN, hL, hLd⟩ := Nat.find_spec hp
  refine ⟨L, hLN, hL, ?_⟩
  intro M hML hM
  have hMN : M.IsSubdiagramOf N := hML.trans hLN
  have hmin : d ≤ M.totalFinrank :=
    Nat.find_min' hp ⟨M, hMN, hM, rfl⟩
  have hle : M.totalFinrank ≤ L.totalFinrank :=
    totalFinrank_mono hfinite hML
  have heq : M.totalFinrank = L.totalFinrank := by
    have hupper : M.totalFinrank ≤ d := hle.trans_eq hLd
    have hMd : M.totalFinrank = d := le_antisymm hupper hmin
    exact hMd.trans hLd.symm
  exact eq_of_isSubdiagramOf_of_totalFinrank_eq hfinite hML heq

statement:

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.rootKernel_isZero_iff
statement:
theorem rootKernel_isZero_iff
    (F : (BoundaryIndex T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k) :
    (rootKernel (k := k) (T := T) F).IsZero ↔
      ∀ t : T, Function.Injective (boundaryDiagramRootMap k T F t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    simpa using h (op (.nonroot t : BoundaryIndex T))
  · intro h q
    cases q using Opposite.rec with
    | _ q =>
        cases q with
        | root => rfl
        | nonroot t =>
            exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (h t)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.injective_rootMaps_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram
statement:
theorem injective_rootMaps_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram
    (F : (BoundaryIndex T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k) :
    (∀ t : T, Function.Injective (boundaryDiagramRootMap k T F t)) ↔
      ∀ N : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
        N.SupportedAwayFromRoot → N.IsZero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinjective N hroot q
    cases q using Opposite.rec with
    | _ q =>
        cases q with
        | root => exact hroot
        | nonroot t =>
            apply bot_unique
            intro x hx
            apply hinjective t
            have hmap := N.map (boundaryRootArrow T t) hx
            rw [hroot] at hmap
            change boundaryDiagramRootMap k T F t x = 0 at hmap
            simpa using hmap
  · intro h
    rw [← rootKernel_isZero_iff (k := k) (T := T) F]
    exact h (rootKernel (k := k) (T := T) F)
      (rootKernel_supportedAwayFromRoot (k := k) (T := T) F)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundarySubdiagram.no_supportedAwaySubdiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot
statement:
theorem no_supportedAwaySubdiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot [Fintype T]
    (F : (BoundaryIndex T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k)
    (hfinite : ∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q))) :
    (∀ N : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
        N.SupportedAwayFromRoot → N.IsZero) ↔
      ∀ L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F, L.IsSimple → L.MeetsRoot
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h L hsimple hroot
    exact hsimple.1 (h L hroot)
  · intro h N hroot
    by_contra hN
    obtain ⟨L, hLN, hsimple⟩ := exists_simple_subdiagram hfinite N hN
    exact h L hsimple (hLN.supportedAwayFromRoot hroot)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.isFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram
statement:
theorem isFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram
    (F : (BoundaryIndex T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k) :
    IsFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram k T F ↔
      (∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q))) ∧
        ∀ N : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
          N.SupportedAwayFromRoot → N.IsZero
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram]
  refine and_congr_right' ?_
  simpa [boundaryDiagramRootMap] using
    BoundarySubdiagram.injective_rootMaps_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram
      (k := k) (T := T) F

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.isFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot
statement:
theorem isFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot
    [Fintype T]
    (F : (BoundaryIndex T)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k) :
    IsFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram k T F ↔
      (∀ q : BoundaryIndex T, Module.Finite k (F.obj (op q))) ∧
        ∀ L : BoundarySubdiagram k T F,
          L.IsSimple → L.MeetsRoot
proof:
:= by
  rw [isFiniteInjectiveBoundaryDiagram_iff_no_supportedAwaySubdiagram]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, haway⟩
    exact ⟨hfinite,
      (BoundarySubdiagram.no_supportedAwaySubdiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot
        F hfinite).mp haway⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hsimple⟩
    exact ⟨hfinite,
      (BoundarySubdiagram.no_supportedAwaySubdiagram_iff_every_simple_meetsRoot
        F hfinite).mpr hsimple⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.arrowTotal_eq_two_mul_vertexTotal_sub_length_sub_two
statement:
theorem arrowTotal_eq_two_mul_vertexTotal_sub_length_sub_two
    {L : ℕ} (verticesAt : Fin (L + 1) → ℤ)
    (arrowsAt : Fin L → ℤ)
    (source_singleton : verticesAt 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : verticesAt (Fin.last L) = 1)
    (slice_tree_edges :
      ∀ j : Fin L,
        arrowsAt j =
          verticesAt j.castSucc + verticesAt j.succ - 1) :
    arrowTotal arrowsAt =
      2 * vertexTotal verticesAt - (L : ℤ) - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hCast := Fin.sum_univ_castSucc verticesAt
  have hSucc := Fin.sum_univ_succ verticesAt
  rw [vertexTotal]
  rw [arrowTotal]
  simp_rw [slice_tree_edges]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.intrinsicExcessFromCounts_eq_length_sub_projectives_sub_one
statement:

    {L : ℕ} (verticesAt : Fin (L + 1) → ℤ)
    (arrowsAt : Fin L → ℤ) (projectives : ℤ)
    (source_singleton : verticesAt 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : verticesAt (Fin.last L) = 1)
    (slice_tree_edges :
      ∀ j : Fin L,
        arrowsAt j =
          verticesAt j.castSucc + verticesAt j.succ - 1) :
    intrinsicExcessFromCounts
        (vertexTotal verticesAt) (arrowTotal arrowsAt) projectives =
      (L : ℤ) - (projectives - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arrowTotal_eq_two_mul_vertexTotal_sub_length_sub_two
    verticesAt arrowsAt source_singleton sink_singleton slice_tree_edges]
  simp only [intrinsicExcessFromCounts]
  ring

    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (Phi : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (verticesAt : Fin (L + 1) → ℤ)
    (arrowsAt : Fin L → ℤ) (projectives : ℤ)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.arrow_error_bound_from_partition
statement:
theorem arrow_error_bound_from_partition {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : α → α → ℕ) (g : β → β → ℕ)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (m h B : ℕ) (hm : 2 * h ≤ m)
    (hi : (∑ b : {b : α // P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val) =
      (m - 2 * h + 1) * ∑ b : β, ∑ a : β, g a b)
    (hb : (∑ b : {b : α // ¬ P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val) ≤ B) :
    |ARCount.arrowCount f - ((m : ℤ) + 1) * ARCount.arrowCount g| ≤
      (B : ℤ) + 2 * h * ARCount.arrowCount g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpart := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype P (fun b ↦ ∑ a : α, f a b)
  rw [hi] at hpart
  have hz := congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) hpart
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hm, Nat.cast_ofNat,
    Nat.cast_one] at hz
  have hbz : (((∑ b : {b : α // ¬ P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ B :=
    by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hbn := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℤ) (∑ b : {b : α // ¬ P b}, ∑ a : α, f a b.val)
  have hgn := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℤ) (∑ b : β, ∑ a : β, g a b)
  have hhn := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℤ) h
  have hBn := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℤ) B
  have hf : ARCount.arrowCount f = ((∑ b : α, ∑ a : α, f a b) : ℕ) := by
    simp only [ARCount.arrowCount, Nat.cast_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  have hg : ARCount.arrowCount g = ((∑ b : β, ∑ a : β, g a b) : ℕ) := by
    simp only [ARCount.arrowCount, Nat.cast_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hf, hg, abs_le]
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.kernelInclusion_comp
statement:
theorem kernelInclusion_comp {X Y : Obj k T} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    kernelInclusion f ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change f.linear x.1 = 0
  exact x.2

    (hf : BoundarySurjective f) (q : X ⟶ Z)
    (hq : kernelInclusion f ≫ q = 0) :
    f ≫ hf.desc q hq = q
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [desc]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryRelationMap_comp
statement:
theorem boundaryRelationMap_comp (Y : Obj k T) :
    boundaryRelationMap Y ≫ boundaryCoverMap Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryRelationMap, Category.assoc,
    kernelInclusion_comp, comp_zero]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_weakCokernel
statement:
theorem boundaryCoverMap_weakCokernel
    (Y : Obj k T) {Z : Obj k T} (q : boundaryCover Y ⟶ Z)
    (hq : boundaryRelationMap Y ≫ q = 0) :
    ∃ s : Y ⟶ Z, boundaryCoverMap Y ≫ s = q
proof:
:= by
  let c := boundaryCoverMap (boundaryKernel Y)
  haveI : Epi c := boundaryCoverMap_epi (boundaryKernel Y)
  have hkernel : kernelInclusion (boundaryCoverMap Y) ≫ q = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_epi c).1
    simpa only [c, boundaryRelationMap, Category.assoc, comp_zero] using hq
  let hf := boundaryCoverMap_boundarySurjective Y
  exact ⟨hf.desc q hkernel, hf.comp_desc q hkernel⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.sum_supported_single_shift
statement:
theorem sum_supported_single_shift {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {α : Type v}
    [DecidableEq α] (F : ι → Finset α) (s : α) (hs : ∀ i, s ∈ F i)
    (w : ι → ℕ) :
    (∑ a : (i : ι) × ↥(F i), if a.2.val = s then w a.1 else 0) = ∑ i, w i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨s, hs i⟩ : ↥(F i))]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    have hbs : b.val ≠ s := fun h ↦ hb (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [hbs]
  · simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.sum_eq_of_supported_single_shift
statement:
theorem sum_eq_of_supported_single_shift {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {α : Type v}
    [DecidableEq α] (F : ι → Finset α) (s : α) (hs : ∀ i, s ∈ F i)
    (w : ι → ℕ) (f : ((i : ι) × ↥(F i)) → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a = if a.2.val = s then w a.1 else 0) :
    (∑ a, f a) = ∑ i, w i
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ ↦ hf a)).trans
    (sum_supported_single_shift F s hs w)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.orbitClassifierDescend_bijective
statement:
theorem orbitClassifierDescend_bijective
    {Y : Type*} (c : X → Y)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), c (g • x) = c x)
    (surjective : Function.Surjective c)
    (fiber : ∀ x y, c x = c y → ∃ g : G, g • y = x) :
    Function.Bijective (orbitClassifierDescend c invariant)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro q r hqr
    induction q using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | _ x =>
        induction r using Quotient.inductionOn' with
        | _ y =>
            apply Quotient.sound
            obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := fiber x y hqr
            rw [← hg]
            exact MulAction.mem_orbit y g
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := surjective y
    exact ⟨Quotient.mk'' x, rfl⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_orbitInvariantDescend_eq_sum_of_orbitClassifier
statement:
theorem sum_orbitInvariantDescend_eq_sum_of_orbitClassifier
    {Y M : Type*} [Fintype X]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X)] [Fintype Y]
    [AddCommMonoid M]
    (c : X → Y)
    (c_invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), c (g • x) = c x)
    (c_surjective : Function.Surjective c)
    (c_fiber : ∀ x y, c x = c y → ∃ g : G, g • y = x)
    (f : X → M)
    (f_invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = f x)
    (t : Y → M)
    (value_eq : ∀ x, f x = t (c x)) :
    (∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
        orbitInvariantDescend f f_invariant q) =
      ∑ y : Y, t y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Fintype.sum_bijective (orbitClassifierDescend c c_invariant)
    (orbitClassifierDescend_bijective c c_invariant c_surjective c_fiber)
  intro q
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ x => exact value_eq x

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_eq_card_nsmul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend
statement:
theorem sum_eq_card_nsmul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Fintype G] [Fintype X]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X)]
    [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (f : X → M)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = f x) :
    (∑ x, f x) = Fintype.card G •
      ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
        orbitInvariantDescend f invariant q
proof:
:= by
  let e := MulAction.selfEquivOrbitsQuotientProd (G := G) (X := X)
    (fun x ↦ IsCancelSMul.stabilizer_eq_bot x)
  calc
    (∑ x, f x) =
        ∑ p : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X × G,
          orbitInvariantDescend f invariant p.1 := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
      intro x
      rfl
    _ = Fintype.card G •
        ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
          orbitInvariantDescend f invariant q := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ]
      rw [Finset.sum_nsmul]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_eq_card_mul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend
statement:
theorem sum_eq_card_mul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend
    [Fintype G] [Fintype X]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X)]
    [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (f : X → ℤ)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x : X), f (g • x) = f x) :
    (∑ x, f x) = (Fintype.card G : ℤ) *
      ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X,
        orbitInvariantDescend f invariant q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using
    sum_eq_card_nsmul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend f invariant

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.card_eq_orbitQuotient_card_mul_group_card
statement:
theorem card_eq_orbitQuotient_card_mul_group_card
    {Q : Type u} [Group Q] {Y : Type v} [MulAction Q Y]
    [IsCancelSMul Q Y] [Fintype Q] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Y)] :
    Fintype.card Y =
      Fintype.card (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Y) * Fintype.card Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_prod]
  exact Fintype.card_congr
    (MulAction.selfEquivOrbitsQuotientProd (G := Q) (X := Y)
      (fun y ↦ IsCancelSMul.stabilizer_eq_bot y))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.eulerSurplus_scale_of_free_actions
statement:
theorem eulerSurplus_scale_of_free_actions
    {Q : Type u} [Group Q] {Arrow Mesh : Type v}
    [MulAction Q Arrow] [MulAction Q Mesh]
    [IsCancelSMul Q Arrow] [IsCancelSMul Q Mesh]
    [Fintype Q] [Fintype Arrow] [Fintype Mesh]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Arrow)]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Mesh)] :
    2 * (Fintype.card Mesh : ℤ) - (Fintype.card Arrow : ℤ) =
      (Fintype.card Q : ℤ) *
        (2 * (Fintype.card (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Mesh) : ℤ) -
          (Fintype.card (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient Q Arrow) : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_orbitQuotient_card_mul_group_card (Q := Q) (Y := Mesh),
    card_eq_orbitQuotient_card_mul_group_card (Q := Q) (Y := Arrow)]
  push_cast
  ring

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.subgroup_smul_orbitQuotient_eq
statement:
private theorem subgroup_smul_orbitQuotient_eq
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (n : N)
    (z : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X) :
    letI
proof:
:= orbitQuotientGroupMulAction (X := X) N
    (n : G) • z = z := by
  letI := orbitQuotientGroupMulAction (X := X) N
  induction z using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ x =>
      apply Quotient.sound
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit x n

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.quotient_smul_orbit_mk

theorem quotient_smul_orbit_mk (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]

    (g : G ⧸ N) •
        (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X) =

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.orbitTowerEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orbitTowerEquiv_mk (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x : X) :
    orbitTowerEquiv N
        (Quotient.mk'' (Quotient.mk'' x :
          MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X)) =
      (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X)
proof:
:= by

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.orbitTowerEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orbitTowerEquiv_symm_mk (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (x : X) :
    (orbitTowerEquiv N).symm
        (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G X) =
