name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceLocalDensity_orbitQuotientMap_mk
statement:
theorem occurrenceLocalDensity_orbitQuotientMap_mk
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (N : Subgroup G) (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (y : Y) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity
        (orbitQuotientMap N target target_equivariant)
        (OrbitQuotientProperty N IsProjective)
        (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N Y) =
      occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [occurrenceLocalDensity, occurrenceLocalDensity,
    orbitQuotientProperty_mk_iff N IsProjective projective_invariant,
    occurrenceIndegree_orbitQuotientMap_mk]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
statement:
theorem occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (y : Y) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective)
        (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) =
      occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [occurrenceLocalDensity, occurrenceLocalDensity,
    groupOrbitQuotientProperty_mk_iff IsProjective projective_invariant,
    occurrenceIndegree_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceLocalDensity_invariant
statement:
theorem occurrenceLocalDensity_invariant
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (g : G) (y : Y) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective (g • y) =
      occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let quotientDensity := occurrenceLocalDensity
    (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
    (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective)
  calc
    occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective (g • y) =
        quotientDensity
          (Quotient.mk'' (g • y) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) :=
      (occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk target
        target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant (g • y)).symm
    _ = quotientDensity
          (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) := by
      apply congrArg quotientDensity
      apply Quotient.sound
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit y g
    _ = occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y :=
      occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk target
        target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant y

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.orbitInvariantDescend_occurrenceLocalDensity
statement:
theorem orbitInvariantDescend_occurrenceLocalDensity
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y) :
    orbitInvariantDescend
        (occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective)
        (occurrenceLocalDensity_invariant target target_equivariant
          IsProjective projective_invariant) q =
      occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ y =>
      exact (occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk target
        target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant y).symm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.sum_occurrenceLocalDensity_eq_group_card_mul_quotient
statement:
theorem sum_occurrenceLocalDensity_eq_group_card_mul_quotient
    [Fintype G] [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y)]
    [IsCancelSMul G Y]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y) :
    (∑ y, occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y) =
      (Fintype.card G : ℤ) *
        ∑ q : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient G Y,
          occurrenceLocalDensity
            (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
            (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective) q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_eq_card_mul_sum_orbitInvariantDescend
    (occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective)
    (occurrenceLocalDensity_invariant target target_equivariant
      IsProjective projective_invariant)]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  exact orbitInvariantDescend_occurrenceLocalDensity target
    target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant q

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceLocalDensity_iteratedOrbitQuotientMap_mk
statement:
theorem occurrenceLocalDensity_iteratedOrbitQuotientMap_mk
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (y : Y) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap
          (orbitQuotientMap N target target_equivariant)
          (orbitQuotientMap_quotient_equivariant N target
            target_equivariant))
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty
          (OrbitQuotientProperty N IsProjective))
        (Quotient.mk'' (Quotient.mk'' y :
          MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N Y) :
            MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (G ⧸ N)
              (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N Y)) =
      occurrenceLocalDensity target IsProjective y
proof:
:= by
  rw [occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk
      (G := G ⧸ N)
      (target := orbitQuotientMap N target target_equivariant)
      (target_equivariant := orbitQuotientMap_quotient_equivariant N target
        target_equivariant)
      (IsProjective := OrbitQuotientProperty N IsProjective)
      (projective_invariant :=
        orbitQuotientProperty_quotient_invariant N IsProjective
          projective_invariant),
    occurrenceLocalDensity_orbitQuotientMap_mk N target
      target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringAction.occurrenceLocalDensity_orbitTowerEquiv
statement:
theorem occurrenceLocalDensity_orbitTowerEquiv
    [IsCancelSMul G Y] [Finite X]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]
    (target : X → Y)
    (target_equivariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (a : X), target (g • a) = g • target a)
    (IsProjective : Y → Prop)
    (projective_invariant :
      ∀ (g : G) (y : Y), IsProjective (g • y) ↔ IsProjective y)
    (z : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (G ⧸ N)
      (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N Y)) :
    occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap
          (orbitQuotientMap N target target_equivariant)
          (orbitQuotientMap_quotient_equivariant N target
            target_equivariant))
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty
          (OrbitQuotientProperty N IsProjective)) z =
      occurrenceLocalDensity
        (groupOrbitQuotientMap target target_equivariant)
        (GroupOrbitQuotientProperty IsProjective)
        (orbitTowerEquiv N z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ q =>
      induction q using Quotient.inductionOn' with
      | _ y =>
          rw [occurrenceLocalDensity_iteratedOrbitQuotientMap_mk N target
              target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant,
            orbitTowerEquiv_mk,
            occurrenceLocalDensity_groupOrbitQuotientMap_mk target
              target_equivariant IsProjective projective_invariant]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_minimalIn_le_two
statement:
theorem card_minimalIn_le_two
    (hno : ∀ a b c : T, ¬IsThreeAntichain a b c)
    (A : Finset T) :
    (minimalIn A).card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : 2 < (minimalIn A).card := by omega
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, ha, hb, hc, hab, hac, hbc⟩ :=
    Finset.two_lt_card_iff.mp hlt
  apply hno a b c
  have haA := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1
  have hbA := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1
  have hcA := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).1
  have hamin := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hbmin := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  have hcmin := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2
  refine
    { not_ab := ?_
      not_ba := ?_
      not_ac := ?_
      not_ca := ?_
      not_bc := ?_
      not_cb := ?_ }
  · intro hle
    exact hbmin a haA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hab)
  · intro hle
    exact hamin b hbA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hab.symm)
  · intro hle
    exact hcmin a haA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hac)
  · intro hle
    exact hamin c hcA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hac.symm)
  · intro hle
    exact hcmin b hbA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hbc)
  · intro hle
    exact hbmin c hcA (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hbc.symm)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.exists_injective_successor
statement:
theorem exists_injective_successor
    (hno : ∀ a b c : T, ¬IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    ∃ f : T → T ⊕ Fin 2, Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ x, successorRel x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective
    (successorRel (T := T))).mp
  intro A
  let M := minimalIn A
  have hMcard : Fintype.card M ≤ Fintype.card (Fin 2) := by
    simpa [M] using card_minimalIn_le_two hno A
  let e : M ↪ Fin 2 :=
    Classical.choice (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hMcard)
  let g : A → T ⊕ Fin 2 := fun a ↦
    if ha : a.1 ∈ M then Sum.inr (e ⟨a.1, ha⟩)
    else Sum.inl a.1
  have hg_injective : Function.Injective g := by
    intro a b hab
    by_cases ha : a.1 ∈ M <;> by_cases hb : b.1 ∈ M
    · have he : (⟨a.1, ha⟩ : M) = ⟨b.1, hb⟩ := by
        apply e.injective
        simpa [g, ha, hb] using hab
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : M ↦ z.1) he
    · simp [g, ha, hb] at hab
    · simp [g, ha, hb] at hab
    · exact Subtype.ext (by simpa [g, ha, hb] using hab)
  have hg_mem (a : A) : ∃ x ∈ A, successorRel x (g a) := by
    by_cases ha : a.1 ∈ M
    · exact ⟨a.1, a.2, by simp [g, ha, successorRel]⟩
    · have hnonmin : ∃ x ∈ A, x < a.1 := by
        have ha' : ¬∀ x, x ∈ A → ¬x < a.1 := by
          intro h
          apply ha
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨a.2, fun x hx ↦ h x hx⟩
        push Not at ha'
        exact ha'
      obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxa⟩ := hnonmin
      exact ⟨x, hxA, by simpa [g, ha, successorRel] using hxa⟩
  let N : Finset (T ⊕ Fin 2) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun z ↦ ∃ x ∈ A, successorRel x z
  let gN : A → N := fun a ↦
    ⟨g a, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hg_mem a⟩⟩
  have hgN_injective : Function.Injective gN := by
    intro a b hab
    apply hg_injective
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  have hcard : A.card ≤ N.card := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective gN hgN_injective
  simpa [N] using hcard

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.card_strictUpperFinset_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem card_strictUpperFinset_lt_of_lt {x y : T} (hxy : x < y) :
    (strictUpperFinset y).card < (strictUpperFinset x).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.card_lt_card
  rw [Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset]
  · exact ⟨y, by simp [strictUpperFinset, hxy],
      by simp [strictUpperFinset]⟩
  · intro z hz
    simp only [strictUpperFinset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] at hz ⊢
    exact lt_trans hxy hz

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.lt_of_next_eq_inl
statement:
theorem lt_of_next_eq_inl {S : Type u} [PartialOrder S]
    (F : TwoSuccessor S) {x y : S} (h : F.next x = Sum.inl y) :
    x < y
proof:
:= by
  have hr := F.related x
  rw [h] at hr
  exact hr

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.trace_of_next_eq_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_of_next_eq_inr {x : T} {d : Fin 2}
    (h : F.next x = Sum.inr d) :
    F.trace x = (d, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace.eq_1, h]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.trace_of_next_eq_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_of_next_eq_inl {x y : T}
    (h : F.next x = Sum.inl y) :
    F.trace x = ((F.trace y).1, (F.trace y).2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace.eq_1, h]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.eq_of_trace_eq
proof:
:= by
  cases hx : F.next x with
  | inl x' =>
      cases hy : F.next y with
      | inl y' =>
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hx,
            F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hy] at htrace
          have hfst := congrArg Prod.fst htrace
          have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd htrace
          have htail : F.trace x' = F.trace y' := by
            apply Prod.ext
            · exact hfst
            · exact Nat.add_right_cancel hsnd
          have hxy : x' = y' := eq_of_trace_eq F htail
          apply F.next_injective
          rw [hx, hy, hxy]
      | inr d =>
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hx,
            F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hy] at htrace
          have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd htrace
          omega
  | inr d =>
      cases hy : F.next y with
      | inl y' =>
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hx,
            F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hy] at htrace
          have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd htrace
          omega
      | inr e =>
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hx,
            F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hy] at htrace
          have hde : d = e := congrArg Prod.fst htrace
          apply F.next_injective
          rw [hx, hy, hde]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.trace_injective
statement:
theorem trace_injective (F : TwoSuccessor T) :
    Function.Injective F.trace
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  exact eq_of_trace_eq F h

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.le_of_trace_fst_eq_of_snd_le
statement:
theorem le_of_trace_fst_eq_of_snd_le
    {S : Type u} [PartialOrder S] [Fintype S]
    (F : TwoSuccessor S) {x y : S}
    (hfst : (F.trace x).1 = (F.trace y).1)
    (hsnd : (F.trace y).2 ≤ (F.trace x).2) :
    x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  cases hx : F.next x with
  | inl x' =>
      rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hx] at hfst hsnd
      by_cases htail : (F.trace y).2 ≤ (F.trace x').2
      · exact (F.lt_of_next_eq_inl hx).le.trans
          (le_of_trace_fst_eq_of_snd_le F hfst htail)
      · have hfirst : (F.trace x).1 = (F.trace y).1 := by
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hx]
          exact hfst
        have hsecond : (F.trace x).2 = (F.trace y).2 := by
          rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inl hx]
          omega
        exact (F.eq_of_trace_eq (Prod.ext hfirst hsecond)).le
  | inr d =>
      rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hx] at hfst hsnd
      have hfirst : (F.trace x).1 = (F.trace y).1 := by
        rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hx]
        exact hfst
      have hsecond : (F.trace x).2 = (F.trace y).2 := by
        rw [F.trace_of_next_eq_inr hx]
        omega
      exact (F.eq_of_trace_eq (Prod.ext hfirst hsecond)).le

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.comparable_of_trace_fst_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (F.trace y).2 (F.trace x).2 with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (F.le_of_trace_fst_eq_of_snd_le hfst h)
  · exact Or.inr (F.le_of_trace_fst_eq_of_snd_le hfst.symm h)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.isChain_terminalFiber
statement:
theorem isChain_terminalFiber (F : TwoSuccessor T) (d : Fin 2) :
    IsChain (· ≤ ·) (terminalFiber F d)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  exact F.comparable_of_trace_fst_eq (hx.trans hy.symm)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.TwoSuccessor.terminalFiber_zero_union_one
statement:
theorem terminalFiber_zero_union_one (F : TwoSuccessor T) :
    terminalFiber F 0 ∪ terminalFiber F 1 = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_union, terminalFiber, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  generalize hd : (F.trace x).1 = d
  fin_cases d <;> simp_all

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.exists_twoSuccessor
statement:
theorem exists_twoSuccessor
    (hno : ∀ a b c : T, ¬IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    Nonempty (TwoSuccessor T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hrel⟩ := exists_injective_successor hno
  exact ⟨⟨f, hf, hrel⟩⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.exists_two_chain_cover_of_no_threeAntichain
statement:
theorem exists_two_chain_cover_of_no_threeAntichain
    (hno : ∀ a b c : T, ¬IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    ∃ A B : Set T,
      A ∪ B = Set.univ ∧
        IsChain (· ≤ ·) A ∧ IsChain (· ≤ ·) B
proof:
:= by
  let F := Classical.choice (exists_twoSuccessor hno)
  exact ⟨F.terminalFiber 0, F.terminalFiber 1,
    F.terminalFiber_zero_union_one,
    F.isChain_terminalFiber 0, F.isChain_terminalFiber 1⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_no_threeAntichain
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_no_threeAntichain
    (X : Obj k T) (hschur : IsSchur k T X)
    (hno : ∀ a b c : T, ¬IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    Module.finrank k X = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hcover, hA, hB⟩ :=
    exists_two_chain_cover_of_no_threeAntichain hno
  exact finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_two_chain_cover
    X hschur A B hcover hA hB

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.exists_threeAntichain_of_isSchur_of_two_le_finrank
statement:
theorem exists_threeAntichain_of_isSchur_of_two_le_finrank
    (X : Obj k T) (hschur : IsSchur k T X)
    (hrank : 2 ≤ Module.finrank k X) :
    ∃ a b c : T, IsThreeAntichain a b c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [not_exists] at hnot
  have hone := finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_no_threeAntichain
    X hschur hnot
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.mem_interactionNeighborhood_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_interactionNeighborhood_iff
    (R : X → X → Prop) (W : Set X) (y : X) :
    y ∈ interactionNeighborhood R W ↔ ∃ x ∈ W, R x y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.subset_interactionNeighborhood
statement:
theorem subset_interactionNeighborhood
    (R : X → X → Prop) (reflexive : ∀ x : X, R x x) (W : Set X) :
    W ⊆ interactionNeighborhood R W
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨x, hx, reflexive x⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.interactionNeighborhood_mono
statement:
theorem interactionNeighborhood_mono
    (R : X → X → Prop) :
    Monotone (interactionNeighborhood R)
proof:
:= by
  intro U W hUW y
  rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
  exact ⟨x, hUW hx, hxy⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.interactionNeighborhood_finite
statement:
theorem interactionNeighborhood_finite
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (locallyFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    (interactionNeighborhood R W).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (hW.biUnion fun x _ ↦ locallyFinite x).subset
  intro y
  rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
  exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem x (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hx hxy)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_zero
    (R : X → X → Prop) (W : Set X) :
    iterateInteractionNeighborhood R 0 W = W
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_succ
    (R : X → X → Prop) (n : ℕ) (W : Set X) :
    iterateInteractionNeighborhood R (n + 1) W =
      interactionNeighborhood R (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite
statement:
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (locallyFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W).Finite
  | 0 => hW
  | n + 1 => interactionNeighborhood_finite R locallyFinite _
      (iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite R locallyFinite W hW n)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_subset_succ
statement:
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_subset_succ
    (R : X → X → Prop) (reflexive : ∀ x : X, R x x)
    (W : Set X) (n : ℕ) :
    iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W ⊆
      iterateInteractionNeighborhood R (n + 1) W
proof:
:=
  subset_interactionNeighborhood R reflexive _

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.interactionNeighborhood_smul
statement:
theorem interactionNeighborhood_smul
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (g : G) (W : Set X) :
    interactionNeighborhood R (g • W) =
      g • interactionNeighborhood R W
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem] at hx
    exact ⟨g⁻¹ • x, hx, (invariant g⁻¹ x y).mpr hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨g • x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx
    · have := (invariant g x (g⁻¹ • y)).mpr hxy
      simpa only [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel, one_smul] using this

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul
statement:
theorem iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (g : G) (W : Set X) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n (g • W) =
        g • iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      change
        interactionNeighborhood R
            (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n (g • W)) =
          g • interactionNeighborhood R
            (iterateInteractionNeighborhood R n W)
      rw [iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul R invariant g W n,
        interactionNeighborhood_smul R invariant]

                                                                           
                
def threeStepControlWindow (R : X → X → Prop) (W : Set X) : Set X
proof:
:=
  iterateInteractionNeighborhood R 3 W

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.threeStepControlWindow_finite
statement:
theorem threeStepControlWindow_finite
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (locallyFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    (threeStepControlWindow R W).Finite
proof:
:=
  iterateInteractionNeighborhood_finite R locallyFinite W hW 3

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.threeStepControlWindow_smul
statement:
theorem threeStepControlWindow_smul
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (g : G) (W : Set X) :
    threeStepControlWindow R (g • W) =
      g • threeStepControlWindow R W
proof:
:=
  iterateInteractionNeighborhood_smul R invariant g W 3

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_threeStepControlWindow
statement:
theorem exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_threeStepControlWindow
    [Group.ResiduallyFinite G]
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (reflexive : ∀ x : X, R x x)
    (neighborsFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (translationsFinite : ∀ x y : X, {g : G | R x (g • y)}.Finite)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G,
      Set.InjOn
          (fun x : X ↦
            (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X))
          (threeStepControlWindow R W) ∧
        ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄,
          x ∈ threeStepControlWindow R W →
          y ∈ threeStepControlWindow R W →
          (OrbitQuotientInteracts (N : Subgroup G) R
              (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X)
              (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X) ↔
            R x y)
proof:
:=
  exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_window R invariant reflexive
    (threeStepControlWindow R W)
    (threeStepControlWindow_finite R neighborsFinite W hW)
    translationsFinite

name: MagnitudeConjecture.CoveringSeparation.exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_threeStepControlWindow_of_finite_support
statement:
theorem
    exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_threeStepControlWindow_of_finite_support
    [Group.ResiduallyFinite G]
    (support : X → Set O)
    (support_finite : ∀ x, (support x).Finite)
    (support_smul : ∀ (g : G) (x : X) (o : O),
      o ∈ support (g • x) ↔ g⁻¹ • o ∈ support x)
    (R : X → X → Prop)
    (invariant : ∀ (g : G) (x y : X), R (g • x) (g • y) ↔ R x y)
    (reflexive : ∀ x : X, R x x)
    (neighborsFinite : ∀ x : X, {y : X | R x y}.Finite)
    (interaction_meets_support : ∀ {x y}, R x y →
      ∃ o, o ∈ support x ∧ o ∈ support y)
    (W : Set X) (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ N : FiniteIndexNormalSubgroup G,
      Set.InjOn
          (fun x : X ↦
            (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X))
          (threeStepControlWindow R W) ∧
        ∀ ⦃x y : X⦄,
          x ∈ threeStepControlWindow R W →
          y ∈ threeStepControlWindow R W →
          (OrbitQuotientInteracts (N : Subgroup G) R
              (Quotient.mk'' x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X)
              (Quotient.mk'' y : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient N X) ↔
            R x y)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_finiteIndexNormalSubgroup_preserving_threeStepControlWindow
    R invariant reflexive neighborsFinite _ W hW
  exact interactionTranslations_finite_of_finite_support support support_finite
    support_smul R interaction_meets_support

name: MagnitudeConjecture.incoming_sum_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem incoming_sum_eq_of_equiv {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : α → α → ℕ) (g : β → β → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a b, f a b = g (e a) (e b)) (b : α) :
    (∑ a, f a b) = ∑ a, g a (e b)
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ ↦ h a b)).trans (e.sum_comp (fun a ↦ g a (e b)))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.weighted_difference
statement:
theorem weighted_difference (a : V → V → ℤ) (h : V → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ x y, a x y ≠ 0 → h y = h x + 1) :
    (∑ x, ∑ y, a x y) =
      (∑ y, h y * ∑ x, a x y) - (∑ x, h x * ∑ y, a x y)
proof:
:= by
  have he : ∀ x y, a x y = h y * a x y - h x * a x y := by
    intro x y
    by_cases hz : a x y = 0
    · simp [hz]
    · rw [ha x y hz]
      ring
  calc
    (∑ x, ∑ y, a x y) = ∑ x, ∑ y, (h y * a x y - h x * a x y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ ↦ he x y)
    _ = (∑ x, ∑ y, h y * a x y) - (∑ x, ∑ y, h x * a x y) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = (∑ y, h y * ∑ x, a x y) - (∑ x, h x * ∑ y, a x y) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.count_of_balance
statement:
theorem count_of_balance (A N p L Hp Hm outside : ℤ)
    (hheight : Hm - Hp = 2 * (N - p))
    (hout : outside = A - p + 1)
    (hbalance : A = 2 * outside + Hp - Hm + L) :
    A = 2 * N - L - 2 ∧ 2 * N - A - p - 1 = L - (p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.incoming_sum_le_of_equiv
statement:
theorem incoming_sum_le_of_equiv {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : α → α → ℕ) (g : β → β → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a b, f a b = g (e a) (e b)) (B : ℕ)
    (hB : ∀ b, (∑ a, g a b) ≤ B) (b : α) : (∑ a, f a b) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a, f a b) = ∑ a, g (e a) (e b) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ ↦ h a b)
    _ = ∑ a, g a (e b) := e.sum_comp (fun a ↦ g a (e b))
    _ ≤ B := hB (e b)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.UpperSetHeight.card_difference_le_height_difference
statement:
theorem card_difference_le_height_difference
    (height : Finset T → ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ U V : Finset T, IsUpperSet (U : Set T) → IsUpperSet (V : Set T) →
      U ⊂ V → height U < height V)
    (U V : Finset T) (hU : IsUpperSet (U : Set T)) (hV : IsUpperSet (V : Set T))
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) : height U + V.card ≤ height V + U.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : WellFoundedLT T := ⟨Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl (· < ·)⟩
  revert hV hUV
  induction V using Finset.strongInductionOn with
  | _ V ih =>
    intro hV hUV
    by_cases heq : U = V
    · subst V
      omega
    have hex : ∃ a : T, a ∈ V ∧ a ∉ U := by
      by_contra! h
      exact heq (Finset.Subset.antisymm hUV h)
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hamin⟩ := exists_minimal_of_wellFoundedLT
      (fun a : T ↦ a ∈ V ∧ a ∉ U) hex
    have hmin : ∀ b ∈ (V : Set T), b ≤ a → b = a := by
      intro b hb hba
      have hbU : b ∉ U := by
        intro hbU
        exact ha.2 (hU hba hbU)
      exact le_antisymm hba (hamin ⟨hb, hbU⟩ hba)
    have hW : IsUpperSet ((V.erase a : Finset T) : Set T) := by
      simpa only [Finset.coe_erase] using hV.erase hmin
    have hUW : U ⊆ V.erase a := by
      intro b hb
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨by intro h; subst b; exact ha.2 hb, hUV hb⟩
    have hproper : V.erase a ⊂ V := Finset.erase_ssubset ha.1
    have hi := ih (V.erase a) hproper hW hUW
    have hs := hstep (V.erase a) V hW hV hproper
    have hc := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha.1
    omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.UpperSetHeight.height_eq_card
statement:
theorem height_eq_card
    (height : Finset T → ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ U V : Finset T, IsUpperSet (U : Set T) → IsUpperSet (V : Set T) →
      U ⊂ V → height U < height V)
    (hbound : height Finset.univ ≤ Fintype.card T)
    (U : Finset T) (hU : IsUpperSet (U : Set T)) : height U = U.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlo := card_difference_le_height_difference height hstep ∅ U
    (by simp [IsUpperSet]) hU (Finset.empty_subset U)
  have hhi := card_difference_le_height_difference height hstep U Finset.univ
    hU (by simp [IsUpperSet]) (Finset.subset_univ U)
  simp only [Finset.card_empty, Finset.card_univ] at hlo hhi
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.mem_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem mem_allowedShifts (m l u : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    t ∈ allowedShifts m l u ↔ 0 ≤ (l : ℤ) + t ∧ (u : ℤ) + t ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [allowedShifts, Finset.mem_Icc]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.card_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem card_allowedShifts (m l u : ℕ) (hum : u ≤ m) :
    ((allowedShifts m l u).card : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 1 - ((u : ℤ) - l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [allowedShifts, Int.card_Icc_of_le
    (a := -(l : ℤ)) (b := (m : ℤ) - u) (by omega)]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.sum_card_allowedShifts
statement:
theorem sum_card_allowedShifts {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (l u : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (hum : ∀ x ∈ s, u x ≤ m) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, ((allowedShifts m (l x) (u x)).card : ℤ) =
      (s.card : ℤ) * ((m : ℤ) + 1) - ∑ x ∈ s, ((u x : ℤ) - l x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ s, ((m : ℤ) + 1 - ((u x : ℤ) - l x)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      exact card_allowedShifts m (l x) (u x) (hum x hx)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.allowedShifts_subset
statement:
theorem allowedShifts_subset (m l u h : ℕ) (hlh : l ≤ h) :
    allowedShifts m l u ⊆ Finset.Icc (-(h : ℤ)) (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  simp only [allowedShifts, Finset.mem_Icc] at ht ⊢
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.incoming_shift_allowed
statement:
theorem incoming_shift_allowed (m h l u : ℕ) (huh : u ≤ h)
    (s t : ℤ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htm : t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h)
    (hst : t ≤ s) (hsth : s ≤ t + h) :
    s ∈ allowedShifts m l u
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_allowedShifts]
  constructor <;> omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.exceptional_shift_mem
statement:
theorem exceptional_shift_mem (m h : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : t ∈ Finset.Icc (-(h : ℤ)) (m : ℤ))
    (hout : ¬ (0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h)) :
    t ∈ Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0 ∪
      Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_Ioc]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.boundary_strip_card_le
statement:
theorem boundary_strip_card_le (m h : ℕ) :
    (Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0 ∪
      Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ)).card ≤ 3 * h
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := Finset.card_union_le
    (Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0)
    (Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ))
  have hleft : (Finset.Ico (-(h : ℤ)) 0).card = h := by
    rw [Int.card_Ico]
    simp
  have hright : (Finset.Ioc ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) (m : ℤ)).card = 2 * h := by
    rw [Int.card_Ioc]
    have heq : (m : ℤ) - ((m : ℤ) - 2 * h) = (2 * h : ℕ) := by omega
    rw [heq]
    exact Int.toNat_natCast (2 * h)
  rw [hleft, hright] at hcard
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le
statement:
theorem exceptional_allowedShifts_card_le (m l u h : ℕ) (hlh : l ≤ h) :
    ((allowedShifts m l u).filter
      (fun t ↦ ¬ (0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (m : ℤ) - 2 * h))).card ≤ 3 * h
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (boundary_strip_card_le m h)
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨ht, hout⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ht
  exact exceptional_shift_mem m h t (allowedShifts_subset m l u h hlh ht) hout

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.weighted_translation_sum
statement:
theorem weighted_translation_sum
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x})
    (h incoming outgoing : V → ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2)
    (ha : ∀ x, incoming x.1 = outgoing (e x).1) :
    (∑ x : {x // ¬ P x}, h x.1 * incoming x.1) =
      (∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, h x.1 * outgoing x.1) +
        2 * ∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, outgoing x.1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ x : {x // ¬ P x}, (h (e x).1 + 2) * outgoing (e x).1 :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ ↦ by rw [he x, ha x])
    _ = ∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, (h x.1 + 2) * outgoing x.1 :=
      e.sum_comp (fun x ↦ (h x.1 + 2) * outgoing x.1)
    _ = _ := by simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.HeightArrowCount.count_of_boundary_sums
statement:
theorem count_of_boundary_sums
    (P I : V → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred I]
    (e : {x // ¬ P x} ≃ {x // ¬ I x})
    (h incoming outgoing : V → ℤ) (A L : ℤ)
    (he : ∀ x, h x.1 = h (e x).1 + 2)
    (ha : ∀ x, incoming x.1 = outgoing (e x).1)
    (hflux : A = (∑ x, h x * incoming x) - ∑ x, h x * outgoing x)
    (htotal : ∑ x, outgoing x = A)
    (hpin : (∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1 * incoming x.1) =
      ∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1)
    (hiout : (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1 * outgoing x.1) =
      (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1) - L)
    (hicount : (∑ x : {x // I x}, outgoing x.1) =
      (Fintype.card {x // P x} : ℤ) - 1) :
    A = 2 * Fintype.card V - L - 2 ∧
      2 * Fintype.card V - A - Fintype.card {x // P x} - 1 =
        L - ((Fintype.card {x // P x} : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htr := weighted_translation_sum P I e h incoming outgoing he ha
  have hp := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype P (fun x ↦ h x * incoming x)
  have hi := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype I (fun x ↦ h x * outgoing x)
  have ho := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype I outgoing
  apply count_of_balance A (Fintype.card V) (Fintype.card {x // P x}) L
    (∑ x : {x // P x}, h x.1) (∑ x : {x // I x}, h x.1)
    (∑ x : {x // ¬ I x}, outgoing x.1)
  · exact boundary_height_difference P I e h he
  · omega
  · omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.sliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem sliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2)) :
    ∀ j, j < L → arrows j = vertices j + vertices (j + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j with
  | zero => exact firstSlice
  | succ j ih =>
      have hj_lt : j < L := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self j) hj
      rw [arrowStep j hj, ih hj_lt, vertexStep j hj]
      ring

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2)) :
    ∀ j : Fin L,
      arrows j.val = vertices j.castSucc.val + vertices j.succ.val - 1
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  simpa using sliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence vertices arrows
    tauInjectives tauProjectives firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep j.val j.isLt

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.arrowTotal_eq_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem arrowTotal_eq_of_translationRecurrence
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2)) :
    arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) =
      2 * vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - (L : ℤ) - 2
proof:
:= by
  apply arrowTotal_eq_two_mul_vertexTotal_sub_length_sub_two
  · simpa using source_singleton
  · simpa using sink_singleton
  · exact finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence vertices arrows
      tauInjectives tauProjectives firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.intrinsicExcessFromCounts_eq_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem intrinsicExcessFromCounts_eq_of_translationRecurrence
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2)) :
    intrinsicExcessFromCounts
        (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val))
        (arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val)) projectives =
      (L : ℤ) - (projectives - 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply intrinsicExcessFromCounts_eq_length_sub_projectives_sub_one
  · simpa using source_singleton
  · simpa using sink_singleton
  · exact finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence vertices arrows
      tauInjectives tauProjectives firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (Phi : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives))
    (realization_length_bound : projectives - 1 ≤ (L : ℤ)) :
    0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative Phi
    (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val)
    (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) projectives
  · simpa using source_singleton
  · simpa using sink_singleton
  · exact finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence vertices arrows
      tauInjectives tauProjectives firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
  · exact meshEulerTotal
  · exact realization_length_bound

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
statement:
theorem matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (Phi : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives)) :
    intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 0 ↔ (L : ℤ) = projectives - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_iff Phi
    (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val)
    (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) projectives
  · simpa using source_singleton
  · simpa using sink_singleton
  · exact finiteSliceEdgeCount_of_translationRecurrence vertices arrows
      tauInjectives tauProjectives firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
  · exact meshEulerTotal

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
statement:
theorem matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (Phi : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    {k T : Type w} [Field k] [PartialOrder T] [Fintype T]
    (projectives_eq : projectives = (Fintype.card T : ℤ) + 1)
    (grading : PosetSpace.PositiveGrading
      (PosetSpace.Obj k T) (PosetSpace.IsSchur k T) L)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives)) :
    0 ≤ intrinsicEulerExcess Phi
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card T ≤ L :=
    PosetSpace.card_le_of_schurPositiveGrading k T grading
  have hcardZ : (Fintype.card T : ℤ) ≤ (L : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  apply matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_nonnegative_of_translationRecurrence
    Phi vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
    source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
    meshEulerTotal
  rw [projectives_eq]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedTreeExcess.finrank_eq_one_of_matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one_of_matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_of_translationRecurrence_and_posetSpace
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (Phi : Matrix ι ι ℤ)
    {L : ℕ} (vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives : ℕ → ℤ)
    (projectives : ℤ)
    {k T : Type w} [Field k] [PartialOrder T] [Fintype T]
    (projectives_eq : projectives = (Fintype.card T : ℤ) + 1)
    (grading : PosetSpace.PositiveGrading
      (PosetSpace.Obj k T) (PosetSpace.IsSchur k T) L)
    (source_singleton : vertices 0 = 1)
    (sink_singleton : vertices L = 1)
    (firstSlice : arrows 0 = vertices 0 + vertices 1 - 1)
    (arrowStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      arrows (j + 1) =
        arrows j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (vertexStep : ∀ j, j + 1 < L →
      vertices (j + 2) =
        vertices j - tauInjectives j + tauProjectives (j + 2))
    (meshEulerTotal :
      matrixTotal Phi =
        vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) -
          arrowTotal (fun j : Fin L ↦ arrows j.val) +
            (vertexTotal (fun j : Fin (L + 1) ↦ vertices j.val) - projectives))
    (hzero : intrinsicEulerExcess Phi = 0)
    (X : PosetSpace.Obj k T) (hX : PosetSpace.IsSchur k T X) :
    Module.finrank k X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsharpZ : (L : ℤ) = projectives - 1 :=
    (matrixIntrinsicEulerExcess_eq_zero_iff_of_translationRecurrence
      Phi vertices arrows tauInjectives tauProjectives projectives
      source_singleton sink_singleton firstSlice arrowStep vertexStep
      meshEulerTotal).mp hzero
  have hsharp : L = Fintype.card T := by
    rw [projectives_eq] at hsharpZ
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : (L : ℤ) = (Fintype.card T : ℤ))
  exact PosetSpace.finrank_eq_one_of_isSchur_of_positiveGrading_of_le_card
    k T grading (by omega) X hX

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.toFullSupport_linear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFullSupport_linear (Y : Obj k T) :
    (toFullSupport Y).linear = (LinearMap.id : Y →ₗ[k] Y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.mono_of_linear_injective
statement:
theorem mono_of_linear_injective {X Y : Obj k T} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.linear) : Mono f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Z g h hgh
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply hf
  have happ := congrArg (fun q : Z ⟶ Y ↦ q.linear z) hgh
  exact happ

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.epi_of_linear_surjective
statement:
theorem epi_of_linear_surjective {X Y : Obj k T} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.linear) : Epi f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Z g h hgh
  apply Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf y
  have happ := congrArg (fun q : X ⟶ Z ↦ q.linear x) hgh
  exact happ

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.toFullSupport_mono
statement: theorem toFullSupport_mono (Y : Obj k T) : Mono (toFullSupport Y)
proof:
:=
  mono_of_linear_injective (toFullSupport Y) (fun _ _ h ↦ h)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.RepresentableData.essSurj_of_fullSupport_of_closedUnderSubobjects
statement:
theorem essSurj_of_fullSupport_of_closedUnderSubobjects
    (D : RepresentableData k T C)
    (hfull : ∀ Y : Obj k T,
      ∃ X : C, Nonempty (D.obj X ≅ fullSupport Y))
    (hclosed : D.EssentialImageClosedUnderSubobjects) :
    ∀ Y : Obj k T, ∃ X : C, Nonempty (D.obj X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro Y
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hfull Y
  let m : Y ⟶ D.obj X := toFullSupport Y ≫ e.inv
  haveI : Mono (toFullSupport Y) := toFullSupport_mono Y
  haveI : Mono e.inv := inferInstance
  have hm : Mono m := inferInstance
  exact hclosed m hm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_add
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_add {κ : Type v} [Fintype κ] (M N : Matrix ι κ ℤ) :
    matrixTotal (M + N) = matrixTotal M + matrixTotal N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixTotal, Matrix.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_sum
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_sum
    {κ : Type v} [Fintype κ] {σ : Type w} [Fintype σ]
    (M : σ → Matrix ι κ ℤ) :
    matrixTotal (∑ k, M k) = ∑ k, matrixTotal (M k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixTotal, Matrix.sum_apply]
  calc
    (∑ row, ∑ column, ∑ k, M k row column) =
        ∑ row, ∑ k, ∑ column, M k row column := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro row _
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ row, ∑ column, M k row column := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_singletonMatrix
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_singletonMatrix (row column : ι) :
    matrixTotal (singletonMatrix row column) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixTotal]
  calc
    (∑ i, ∑ j, singletonMatrix row column i j) =
        ∑ i, if i = row then 1 else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          by_cases hi : i = row
          · subst i
            simp [singletonMatrix]
          · simp [singletonMatrix, hi]
    _ = 1 := by simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_one
statement: theorem matrixTotal_one : matrixTotal (1 : Matrix ι ι ℤ) = vertexCount (ι := ι)
proof:
:= by
  simp [matrixTotal, Matrix.one_apply, vertexCount]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_arrowMatrix
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_arrowMatrix (arrowMultiplicity : ι → ι → ℕ) :
    matrixTotal (arrowMatrix arrowMultiplicity) = -arrowCount arrowMultiplicity
proof:
:= by
  simp [matrixTotal, arrowMatrix, arrowCount]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_meshContribution
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_meshContribution
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι) :
    matrixTotal (meshContribution IsProjective tau) = meshCount IsProjective
proof:
:= by
  rw [meshContribution, matrixTotal_sum]
  simp [matrixTotal_singletonMatrix, meshCount]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.meshContribution_apply_of_projective
statement:
theorem meshContribution_apply_of_projective
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι)
    {source target : ι} (hTarget : IsProjective target) :
    meshContribution IsProjective tau source target = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [meshContribution, Matrix.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro Y _
  by_cases h : source = tau Y ∧ target = Y.1
  · exfalso
    apply Y.property
    rw [← h.2]
    exact hTarget
  · simp [singletonMatrix, h]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.meshContribution_apply_of_nonprojective
statement:
theorem meshContribution_apply_of_nonprojective
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι)
    {source target : ι} (hTarget : ¬ IsProjective target) :
    meshContribution IsProjective tau source target =
      if source = tau ⟨target, hTarget⟩ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [meshContribution, Matrix.sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨target, hTarget⟩]
  · simp [singletonMatrix]
  · intro Y _ hY
    by_cases h : source = tau Y ∧ target = Y.1
    · exfalso
      apply hY
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact h.2.symm
    · simp [singletonMatrix, h]
  · simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.meshMatrix_apply_of_projective
statement:
theorem meshMatrix_apply_of_projective
    (arrowMultiplicity : ι → ι → ℕ)
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι)
    {source target : ι} (hTarget : IsProjective target) :
    meshMatrix arrowMultiplicity IsProjective tau source target =
      (if source = target then 1 else 0) - arrowMultiplicity source target
proof:
:= by
  rw [meshMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    arrowMatrix, meshContribution_apply_of_projective IsProjective tau hTarget]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.meshMatrix_apply_of_nonprojective
statement:
theorem meshMatrix_apply_of_nonprojective
    (arrowMultiplicity : ι → ι → ℕ)
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι)
    {source target : ι} (hTarget : ¬ IsProjective target) :
    meshMatrix arrowMultiplicity IsProjective tau source target =
      (if source = target then 1 else 0) - arrowMultiplicity source target +
        if source = tau ⟨target, hTarget⟩ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [meshMatrix, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    arrowMatrix, meshContribution_apply_of_nonprojective IsProjective tau hTarget]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.ARCount.matrixTotal_meshMatrix_eq_eulerMagnitude
statement:
theorem matrixTotal_meshMatrix_eq_eulerMagnitude
    (arrowMultiplicity : ι → ι → ℕ)
    (IsProjective : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred IsProjective]
    (tau : {Y : ι // ¬ IsProjective Y} → ι) :
    matrixTotal (meshMatrix arrowMultiplicity IsProjective tau) =
      eulerMagnitude arrowMultiplicity IsProjective
proof:
:= by
  rw [meshMatrix, matrixTotal_add, matrixTotal_add, matrixTotal_one,
    matrixTotal_arrowMatrix, matrixTotal_meshContribution]
  simp [eulerMagnitude, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.packingEnd_eq
statement:
theorem packingEnd_eq (r h q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    packingEnd r h q = q * (r + h + 1) - h - 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : q * (r + h + 1) = (q - 1) * (r + h + 1) + (r + h + 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hq]
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  unfold packingEnd
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.blockPoint_inBlock
statement:
theorem blockPoint_inBlock (r h q : ℕ) (j : Fin q) (t : Fin (r + 1)) :
    InBlock r h j.val ((blockPoint r h q j t).val : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := t.isLt
  dsimp [blockPoint, InBlock]
  push_cast
  constructor <;> omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.blockPoint_injective
statement:
theorem blockPoint_injective (r h q : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin q × Fin (r + 1) ↦ blockPoint r h q p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro p t he
  have hv := congrArg (fun x : Fin (packingEnd r h q + 1) ↦ (x.val : ℤ)) he
  have hj : p.1.val = t.1.val := block_index_eq_of_close r h
    (blockPoint_inBlock r h q p.1 p.2) (blockPoint_inBlock r h q t.1 t.2)
    (by rw [hv]; simp)
  apply Prod.ext (Fin.ext hj)
  apply Fin.ext
  have hn := congrArg Fin.val he
  change p.1.val * (r + h + 1) + p.2.val = t.1.val * (r + h + 1) + t.2.val at hn
  rw [hj] at hn
  exact Nat.add_left_cancel hn

name: MagnitudeConjecture.GradedInterval.exists_blockPoint_of_retained
statement:
theorem exists_blockPoint_of_retained (r h q : ℕ)
    (d : Fin (packingEnd r h q + 1)) (hd : Retained r h q (d.val : ℤ)) :
    ∃ p : Fin q × Fin (r + 1), blockPoint r h q p.1 p.2 = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hlo, hhi⟩ := hd
  have hlo' : j * (r + h + 1) ≤ d.val := by exact_mod_cast hlo
  have hhi' : d.val ≤ j * (r + h + 1) + r := by exact_mod_cast hhi
  refine ⟨(⟨j, hj⟩, ⟨d.val - j * (r + h + 1), by omega⟩), ?_⟩
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [blockPoint]
  omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryLE_refl
statement: theorem boundaryLE_refl [Preorder T] (q : Option T) : boundaryLE q q
proof:
:= by
  cases q <;> simp [boundaryLE]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryLE_trans
statement:
theorem boundaryLE_trans [Preorder T] {q r s : Option T} :
    boundaryLE q r → boundaryLE r s → boundaryLE q s
proof:
:= by
  intro hqr hrs
  cases q with
  | none => trivial
  | some t =>
      cases r with
      | none => exact False.elim hqr
      | some r =>
          cases s with
          | none => exact False.elim hrs
          | some s => exact hrs.trans hqr

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryLE_antisymm
statement:
theorem boundaryLE_antisymm [PartialOrder T] {q r : Option T}
    (hqr : boundaryLE q r) (hrq : boundaryLE r q) : q = r
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | none =>
      cases r <;> simp_all [boundaryLE]
  | some t =>
      cases r with
      | none => simp_all [boundaryLE]
      | some s =>
          simp only [boundaryLE] at hqr hrq
          exact congrArg some (le_antisymm hrq hqr)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundaryIndex.toOption_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem BoundaryIndex.toOption_root :
    (BoundaryIndex.root : BoundaryIndex T).toOption = none
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundaryIndex.toOption_nonroot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem BoundaryIndex.toOption_nonroot (t : T) :
    (BoundaryIndex.nonroot t).toOption = some t
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.BoundaryIndex.toOption_injective
statement:
theorem BoundaryIndex.toOption_injective :
    Function.Injective (BoundaryIndex.toOption (T := T))
proof:
:= by
  intro q r h
  cases q <;> cases r <;> simp_all

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryLE_toOption_iff_le
statement:
theorem boundaryLE_toOption_iff_le [PartialOrder T]
    (q r : BoundaryIndex T) :
    boundaryLE q.toOption r.toOption ↔ q ≤ r
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RankedReachability.source_reaches
statement:
theorem source_reaches (rank : V → ℕ) (E : V → V → Prop)
    (hE : ∀ x y, E x y → rank x < rank y)
    (source : V) (hsource : ∀ x, (¬ ∃ y, E y x) → x = source) :
    ∀ x, Relation.ReflTransGen E source x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  induction x using (measure rank).wf.induction with
  | h x ih =>
    by_cases hx : ∃ y, E y x
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
      exact (ih y (hE y x hy)).tail hy
    · rw [hsource x hx]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.coPrincipalSupport_isUpperSet
statement:
theorem coPrincipalSupport_isUpperSet (t : T) :
    IsUpperSet (coPrincipalSupport t)
proof:
:= by
  intro s r hsr hs hrt
  exact hs (hsr.trans hrt)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.homToCoPrincipalLine_vanishes
statement:
theorem homToCoPrincipalLine_vanishes (t : T) (X : Obj k T)
    (f : X ⟶ coPrincipalLine (k := k) t) :
    X.subspace t ≤ LinearMap.ker f.linear
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have htarget := f.map_subspace t x hx
  rw [line_subspace_of_not_mem k T (coPrincipalSupport t)
    (coPrincipalSupport_isUpperSet t) t (by
      simp [coPrincipalSupport])] at htarget
  exact htarget

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_apply [Fintype T]
    (t : T) (X : Obj k T) (x : X)
    (f : X ⟶ coPrincipalLine (k := k) t) :
    incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t X x f = f.linear x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_ker
statement:
theorem incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_ker [Fintype T]
    (t : T) (X : Obj k T) :
    LinearMap.ker (incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t X) = X.subspace t
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceBoundaryEvaluation, LinearMap.ker_comp, LinearEquiv.ker,
    Submodule.comap_bot, Submodule.ker_mkQ]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_surjective [Fintype T]
    (t : T) (X : Obj k T) :
    Function.Surjective (incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t X)
proof:
:= by
  exact (quotientEquivDualHomToCoPrincipalLine t X).surjective.comp
    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (X.subspace t))

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_natural
statement:
theorem incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_natural [Fintype T]
    (t : T) {X Y : Obj k T} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t Y (f.linear x) =
      (homToCoPrincipalLinePrecomposition t f).dualMap
        (incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t X x)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro g
  simp [homToCoPrincipalLinePrecomposition]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.principalSubspace_incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_exact
statement:
theorem principalSubspace_incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_exact [Fintype T]
    (t : T) (X : Obj k T) :
    Function.Exact (X.subspace t).subtype
      (incidenceBoundaryEvaluation t X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
  exact (incidenceBoundaryEvaluation_ker t X).trans
    (X.subspace t).range_subtype.symm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.homFromPrincipalLine_nonzero_iff_homToCoPrincipalLine_eq_zero
statement:
theorem homFromPrincipalLine_nonzero_iff_homToCoPrincipalLine_eq_zero
    [Fintype T] (t : T) (X : Obj k T)
    (hX : Module.finrank k X = 1) :
    (∃ f : line k T (Set.Ici t) (isUpperSet_Ici t) ⟶ X, f ≠ 0) ↔
      (∀ g : X ⟶ coPrincipalLine (k := k) t, g = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let EP := homFromPrincipalLineEquiv t X
  let EQ := homToCoPrincipalLineEquiv t X
  have hsum := (X.subspace t).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [hX] at hsum
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have hPpos : 0 < Module.finrank k (X.subspace t) := by
      apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
      refine ⟨EP f, ?_⟩
      intro hzero
      apply hf
      apply EP.injective
      simpa using hzero
    have hquot : Module.finrank k (X ⧸ X.subspace t) = 0 := by
      omega
    have hdualzero : Module.finrank k
        (Module.Dual k (X ⧸ X.subspace t)) = 0 := by
      rw [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq, hquot]
    have hsubsingle : Subsingleton
        (Module.Dual k (X ⧸ X.subspace t)) :=
      Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hdualzero
    intro g
    apply EQ.injective
    exact Subsingleton.elim (EQ g) (EQ 0)
  · intro hzero
    have hdualsubsingle : Subsingleton
        (Module.Dual k (X ⧸ X.subspace t)) := by
      constructor
      intro f g
      calc
        f = EQ (EQ.symm f) := (EQ.apply_symm_apply f).symm
        _ = EQ 0 := by rw [hzero (EQ.symm f)]
        _ = EQ (EQ.symm g) :=
          (congrArg EQ (hzero (EQ.symm g))).symm
        _ = g := EQ.apply_symm_apply g
    have hdualzero : Module.finrank k
        (Module.Dual k (X ⧸ X.subspace t)) = 0 :=
      Module.finrank_zero_iff.mpr hdualsubsingle
    have hquot : Module.finrank k (X ⧸ X.subspace t) = 0 := by
      rw [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq] at hdualzero
      exact hdualzero
    have hPpos : 0 < Module.finrank k (X.subspace t) := by
      omega
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hPpos
    refine ⟨EP.symm x, ?_⟩
    intro hzeroP
    apply hx
    have happ := congrArg EP hzeroP
    simpa using happ

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.IsThreeAntichain.ne_ab
statement: theorem ne_ab (H : IsThreeAntichain a b c) : a ≠ b
proof:
:= by

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.IsThreeAntichain.ne_bc

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.not_aboveThree_a
statement:
theorem not_aboveThree_a {a b c : T} (H : IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    ¬aboveThree a b c a
proof:
:= by
  rintro (haa | hba | hca)
  · exact (lt_irrefl a) haa
  · exact H.not_ba hba.le
  · exact H.not_ca hca.le

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.not_aboveThree_b
statement:
theorem not_aboveThree_b {a b c : T} (H : IsThreeAntichain a b c) :
    ¬aboveThree a b c b
proof:

  · exact H.not_ab hab.le
  · exact (lt_irrefl b) hbb
  · exact H.not_cb hcb.le

name: MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.not_aboveThree_c
statement:

  · exact H.not_bc hbc.le
