statement:
theorem standardFormProjective_projectiveInjectiveCopresentation_nonempty
    (P : CategoryTheory.ProjectiveObject
      S.StandardFormFiniteContravariantModuleCategory) :
    Nonempty (LeftFreyd.ProjectiveInjectiveCopresentation P.obj)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := S.standardFormRightMeshData
  let hP := S.standardFormFiniteContravariantRepresentables
  obtain ⟨Q⟩ := finiteRepresentableCoordinates_nonempty_of_projective
    hP (fun X ↦ S.standardFormOppositeVertexCategoryEndLocal X) P.obj
  let R (j : Fin Q.n) :=
    T.contravariantRepresentableFiniteModule (k := k) hP (Q.X j).unop
  let Irep (j : Fin Q.n) :
      LeftFreyd.ProjectiveInjectiveCopresentation (R j) :=
    S.standardFormContravariantRepresentableProjectiveInjectiveCopresentation
      (Q.X j).unop
  let ecoord (j : Fin Q.n) : R j ≅
      (finiteDimensionalLinearCoyonedaFunctor (k := k) hP).obj
        (Opposite.op (Q.X j)) :=
    (T.contravariantRepresentableFiniteIso (k := k) hP (Q.X j).unop).symm
  let Icoord (j : Fin Q.n) :
      LeftFreyd.ProjectiveInjectiveCopresentation
        ((finiteDimensionalLinearCoyonedaFunctor (k := k) hP).obj
          (Opposite.op (Q.X j))) :=
    (Irep j).ofIso (ecoord j)
  let Isum := LeftFreyd.ProjectiveInjectiveCopresentation.biproduct
    (fun j ↦ (finiteDimensionalLinearCoyonedaFunctor (k := k) hP).obj
      (Opposite.op (Q.X j))) Icoord
  exact ⟨Isum.ofIso Q.isoSource⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.simpleCount_mapAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem simpleCount_mapAlgEquiv
    (S : RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton k A) (f : A ≃ₐ[k] B) :
    (S.mapAlgEquiv f).simpleCount = S.simpleCount
proof:
:= by
  let e : S.ProjectiveLabel ≃ (S.mapAlgEquiv f).ProjectiveLabel :=
    { toFun := fun p ↦ ⟨p.label, Projective.of_iso
        (S.mapAlgEquivObjIso f p.label)
          (((fgModuleEquivalenceOfAlgEquiv f).map_projective_iff
            (S.fgObj p.label)).2 p.projective)⟩
      invFun := fun q ↦ ⟨q.label,
        ((fgModuleEquivalenceOfAlgEquiv f).map_projective_iff
          (S.fgObj q.label)).1
            (Projective.of_iso (S.mapAlgEquivObjIso f q.label).symm
              q.projective)⟩
      left_inv := by intro p; cases p; rfl
      right_inv := by intro q; cases q; rfl }
  rw [(S.mapAlgEquiv f).simpleCount_eq_card_projectiveLabel,
    S.simpleCount_eq_card_projectiveLabel]
  exact (Fintype.card_congr e).symm

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.eq_of_codomainHom_uniserial
statement:
theorem eq_of_codomainHom_uniserial [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    {x y : S.ProjectiveLabel}
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))
    (a b : S.OrdinaryArrow x y) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hab
  let Q := S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule x y
  have hli := D.homModSquare_linearIndependent x y
  rcases huni.smul_comparable (D.hom a) (D.hom b) with habMul | hbaMul
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := habMul
    change D.hom a ≫ End.asHom r = D.hom b at hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      S.exists_scalar_sub_mem_projectiveRadical x (End.asHom r)
    have hsq : D.hom a ≫
        (End.asHom r - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) ∈ Q := by
      change D.hom a ≫
        (End.asHom r - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) ∈
          (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
      rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
        HomIdeal.pow_one]
      exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul (D.hom_mem_radical a) hc
    have hzero : Q.mkQ
        (D.hom b - c • D.hom a) = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hr]
      simpa only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Linear.comp_smul,
        Category.comp_id] using hsq
    have hrel : Q.mkQ (D.hom b) = c • Q.mkQ (D.hom a) := by
      rw [Q.mkQ.map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
      exact hzero
    apply hli.notMem_span b
    rw [hrel]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, by
      simpa [hab], rfl⟩)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hbaMul
    change D.hom b ≫ End.asHom r = D.hom a at hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      S.exists_scalar_sub_mem_projectiveRadical x (End.asHom r)
    have hsq : D.hom b ≫
        (End.asHom r - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) ∈ Q := by
      change D.hom b ≫
        (End.asHom r - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) ∈
          (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
      rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
        HomIdeal.pow_one]
      exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul (D.hom_mem_radical b) hc
    have hzero : Q.mkQ
        (D.hom a - c • D.hom b) = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hr]
      simpa only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Linear.comp_smul,
        Category.comp_id] using hsq
    have hrel : Q.mkQ (D.hom a) = c • Q.mkQ (D.hom b) := by
      rw [Q.mkQ.map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
      exact hzero
    apply hli.notMem_span a
    rw [hrel]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, by
      simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using Ne.symm hab, rfl⟩)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.eq_of_domainHom_uniserial
statement:
theorem eq_of_domainHom_uniserial [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    {x y : S.ProjectiveLabel}
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y))ᵐᵒᵖ
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))
    (a b : S.OrdinaryArrow x y) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hab
  let Q := S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule x y
  have hli := D.homModSquare_linearIndependent x y
  rcases huni.smul_comparable (D.hom a) (D.hom b) with habMul | hbaMul
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := habMul
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫ D.hom a = D.hom b at hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      S.exists_scalar_sub_mem_projectiveRadical y (End.asHom r.unop)
    have hsq :
        (End.asHom r.unop - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y)) ≫
          D.hom a ∈ Q := by
      change
        (End.asHom r.unop - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y)) ≫
          D.hom a ∈
            (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
      rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
        HomIdeal.pow_one]
      exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul hc (D.hom_mem_radical a)
    have hzero : Q.mkQ (D.hom b - c • D.hom a) = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hr]
      simpa only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Linear.smul_comp,
        Category.id_comp] using hsq
    have hrel : Q.mkQ (D.hom b) = c • Q.mkQ (D.hom a) := by
      rw [Q.mkQ.map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
      exact hzero
    apply hli.notMem_span b
    rw [hrel]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, by
      simpa [hab], rfl⟩)
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hbaMul
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫ D.hom b = D.hom a at hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      S.exists_scalar_sub_mem_projectiveRadical y (End.asHom r.unop)
    have hsq :
        (End.asHom r.unop - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y)) ≫
          D.hom b ∈ Q := by
      change
        (End.asHom r.unop - c • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj y)) ≫
          D.hom b ∈
            (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
      rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
        HomIdeal.pow_one]
      exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul hc (D.hom_mem_radical b)
    have hzero : Q.mkQ (D.hom a - c • D.hom b) = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← hr]
      simpa only [Preadditive.sub_comp, Linear.smul_comp,
        Category.id_comp] using hsq
    have hrel : Q.mkQ (D.hom a) = c • Q.mkQ (D.hom b) := by
      rw [Q.mkQ.map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
      exact hzero
    apply hli.notMem_span a
    rw [hrel]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, by
      simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using Ne.symm hab, rfl⟩)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.followingTarget_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
statement:
theorem RightContinuationFork.followingTarget_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
    [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (huni : ∀ z : S.ProjectiveLabel,
      IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∨
        IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    F.following₁.1.1 ≠ F.following₂.1.1
proof:
:= by
  intro htarget
  apply F.distinct
  rcases F with
    ⟨start, middle, first, ⟨⟨z₁, b₁⟩, hb₁⟩, ⟨⟨z₂, b₂⟩, hb₂⟩, hdistinct⟩
  simp only at htarget ⊢
  subst z₂
  rcases huni z₁ with hcodomain | hdomain
  · have hb : b₁ = b₂ :=
      D.eq_of_codomainHom_uniserial hcodomain b₁ b₂
    subst b₂
    rfl
  · have hb : b₁ = b₂ :=
      D.eq_of_domainHom_uniserial hdomain b₁ b₂
    subst b₂
    rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_rightFork_secondComparison
statement:
theorem exists_rightFork_secondComparison
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1))
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    ∃ e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex,
      e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∧
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 =
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ e
proof:
:= by
  have hconnectorComp :
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ∈
        S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule
          F.middleVertex F.following₂.1.1 := by
    change connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ∈
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
      HomIdeal.pow_one]
    exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul hconnector
      (D.hom_mem_radical F.following₁.1.2)
  rcases huni.smul_comparable
      (connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
      (D.hom F.following₂.1.2) with himpossible | hsurviving
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := himpossible
    change (connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2) ≫ End.asHom r =
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 at hr
    exfalso
    apply D.hom_not_mem_radicalSquare F.following₂.1.2
    rw [← hr]
    exact (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).postcomp
      (End.asHom r) hconnectorComp
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hsurviving
    change D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ End.asHom r =
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 at hr
    refine ⟨End.asHom r, ?_, hr.symm⟩
    apply D.codomainEndomorphism_mem_radical_of_comp_mem_radicalSquare
      F.following₂.1.2
    rw [hr]
    exact hconnectorComp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.false_of_rightFork_firstComparison_of_domainHom_uniserial
statement:
theorem false_of_rightFork_firstComparison_of_domainHom_uniserial
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1))
    (hfirst :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first)
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1))ᵐᵒᵖ
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hconnectorComp :
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ∈
        S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule
          F.middleVertex F.following₂.1.1 := by
    change connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ∈
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
      HomIdeal.pow_one]
    exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul hconnector
      (D.hom_mem_radical F.following₁.1.2)
  rcases huni.smul_comparable
      (connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
      (D.hom F.following₂.1.2) with himpossible | hsurviving
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := himpossible
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫
        (connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2) =
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 at hr
    exfalso
    apply D.hom_not_mem_radicalSquare F.following₂.1.2
    rw [← hr]
    exact (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).precomp
      (End.asHom r.unop) hconnectorComp
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hsurviving
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫ D.hom F.following₂.1.2 =
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 at hr
    have hrRadical : End.asHom r.unop ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1) := by
      apply D.domainEndomorphism_mem_radical_of_comp_mem_radicalSquare
        F.following₂.1.2
      rw [hr]
      exact hconnectorComp
    have hfixed :
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
          End.asHom r.unop ≫
            (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) := by
      calc
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
            connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first :=
          hfirst
        _ = (connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2) ≫
            D.hom F.first := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = (End.asHom r.unop ≫
            D.hom F.following₂.1.2) ≫ D.hom F.first := by
          rw [hr]
        _ = End.asHom r.unop ≫
            (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
    have hnilpotent :=
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.isNilpotent_end_of_mem_ideal
        hrRadical
    have hunit : IsUnit (1 - End.of (End.asHom r.unop)) :=
      hnilpotent.isUnit_one_sub
    let u : End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1) :=
      1 - End.of (End.asHom r.unop)
    letI : IsIso (End.asHom u) :=
      (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso u).mp hunit
    have hcompZero :
        End.asHom u ≫
          (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [u]
      change
        ((𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1) -
            End.asHom r.unop) ≫ D.hom F.following₂.1.2) ≫
          D.hom F.first = 0
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp,
        Preadditive.sub_comp]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hfixed
    have hzeroOriginal :
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first = 0 := by
      apply (cancel_epi (End.asHom u)).1
      simpa using hcompZero
    exact F.following₂.2 hzeroOriginal

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_rightFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
statement:
theorem exists_rightFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1))
    (hfirst :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first)
    (huni :
      IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∨
        IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    ∃ e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex,
      e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∧
      connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 =
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ e
proof:
:= by
  rcases huni with hcodomain | hdomain
  · exact D.exists_rightFork_secondComparison F connector hconnector
      hcodomain
  · exact False.elim
      (D.false_of_rightFork_firstComparison_of_domainHom_uniserial
        F connector hconnector hfirst hdomain)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.precedingSource_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
statement:
theorem LeftContinuationFork.precedingSource_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
    [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (huni : ∀ z : S.ProjectiveLabel,
      IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z) ∨
        IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z)) :
    F.preceding₁.1.1 ≠ F.preceding₂.1.1
proof:
:= by
  intro hsource
  apply F.distinct
  rcases F with
    ⟨middle, target, second, ⟨⟨z₁, c₁⟩, hc₁⟩, ⟨⟨z₂, c₂⟩, hc₂⟩, hdistinct⟩
  simp only at hsource ⊢
  subst z₂
  rcases huni z₁ with hcodomain | hdomain
  · have hc : c₁ = c₂ :=
      D.eq_of_codomainHom_uniserial hcodomain c₁ c₂
    subst c₂
    rfl
  · have hc : c₁ = c₂ :=
      D.eq_of_domainHom_uniserial hdomain c₁ c₂
    subst c₂
    rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_leftFork_secondComparison
statement:
theorem exists_leftFork_secondComparison
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1))
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))ᵐᵒᵖ
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)) :
    ∃ e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex,
      e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∧
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector =
        e ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hconnectorComp :
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector ∈
        S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule
          F.preceding₂.1.1 F.middleVertex := by
    change D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector ∈
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
      HomIdeal.pow_one]
    exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul
      (D.hom_mem_radical F.preceding₁.1.2) hconnector
  rcases huni.smul_comparable
      (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector)
      (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) with himpossible | hsurviving
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := himpossible
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫
        (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector) =
      D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 at hr
    exfalso
    apply D.hom_not_mem_radicalSquare F.preceding₂.1.2
    rw [← hr]
    exact (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).precomp
      (End.asHom r.unop) hconnectorComp
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hsurviving
    change End.asHom r.unop ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector at hr
    refine ⟨End.asHom r.unop, ?_, hr.symm⟩
    apply D.domainEndomorphism_mem_radical_of_comp_mem_radicalSquare
      F.preceding₂.1.2
    rw [hr]
    exact hconnectorComp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.false_of_leftFork_firstComparison_of_codomainHom_uniserial
statement:
theorem false_of_leftFork_firstComparison_of_codomainHom_uniserial
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1))
    (hfirst :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector)
    (huni : IsUniserialModule
      (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1))
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hconnectorComp :
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector ∈
        S.projectiveRadicalSquareSubmodule
          F.preceding₂.1.1 F.middleVertex := by
    change D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector ∈
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).hom _ _
    rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 by omega, HomIdeal.pow_add,
      HomIdeal.pow_one]
    exact HomIdeal.comp_mem_mul
      (D.hom_mem_radical F.preceding₁.1.2) hconnector
  rcases huni.smul_comparable
      (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector)
      (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) with himpossible | hsurviving
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := himpossible
    change (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector) ≫
        End.asHom r = D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 at hr
    exfalso
    apply D.hom_not_mem_radicalSquare F.preceding₂.1.2
    rw [← hr]
    exact (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.pow 2).postcomp
      (End.asHom r) hconnectorComp
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hsurviving
    change D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 ≫ End.asHom r =
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector at hr
    have hrRadical : End.asHom r ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1) := by
      apply D.codomainEndomorphism_mem_radical_of_comp_mem_radicalSquare
        F.preceding₂.1.2
      rw [hr]
      exact hconnectorComp
    have hfixed :
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) ≫
            End.asHom r := by
      calc
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
            D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫
              connector := hfirst
        _ = D.hom F.second ≫
            (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector) := rfl
        _ = D.hom F.second ≫
            (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 ≫ End.asHom r) := by
          rw [hr]
        _ = (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) ≫
            End.asHom r := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hnilpotent :=
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.isNilpotent_end_of_mem_ideal
        hrRadical
    have hunit : IsUnit (1 - End.of (End.asHom r)) :=
      hnilpotent.isUnit_one_sub
    let u : End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1) :=
      1 - End.of (End.asHom r)
    letI : IsIso (End.asHom u) :=
      (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso u).mp hunit
    have hcompZero :
        (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) ≫
          End.asHom u = 0 := by
      dsimp only [u]
      change
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 ≫
          (𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1) -
            End.asHom r) = 0
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hfixed
    have hzeroOriginal :
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 = 0 := by
      apply (cancel_mono (End.asHom u)).1
      simpa using hcompZero
    exact F.preceding₂.2 hzeroOriginal

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_leftFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
statement:
theorem exists_leftFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (connector :
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)
    (hconnector : connector ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1))
    (hfirst :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector)
    (huni :
      IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1) ∨
        IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1)) :
    ∃ e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex,
      e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∧
      D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector =
        e ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases huni with hcodomain | hdomain
  · exact False.elim
      (D.false_of_leftFork_firstComparison_of_codomainHom_uniserial
        F connector hconnector hfirst hcodomain)
  · exact D.exists_leftFork_secondComparison F connector hconnector
      hdomain

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_eq_outgoing_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical
statement:
theorem exists_eq_outgoing_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (x : S.ProjectiveLabel)
    (e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)
    (he : e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) :
    ∃ h : ∀ a : Quiver.Costar x,
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj a.1 ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x,
      e = ∑ a : Quiver.Costar x, D.hom a.2 ≫ h a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := D.exists_realization_preimage e
  obtain ⟨r, c, hc⟩ :=
    LinearPathCategory.exists_eq_smul_id_add_outgoingSum q
  let h : ∀ a : Quiver.Costar x,
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj a.1 ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x :=
    fun a ↦ D.realization.map (c a)
  have houtgoing :
      D.realization.map (LinearPathCategory.outgoingSum c) =
        ∑ a : Quiver.Costar x, D.hom a.2 ≫ h a := by
    change
      (LinearPathCategory.lift S.ordinaryProjectiveObj
        (fun {_ _} (a : S.OrdinaryArrow _ _) ↦ D.hom a)).map
          (LinearPathCategory.outgoingSum c) = _
    exact LinearPathCategory.lift_map_outgoingSum
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj
      (fun {_ _} (a : S.OrdinaryArrow _ _) ↦ D.hom a) c
  have heq : e = r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) +
      ∑ a : Quiver.Costar x, D.hom a.2 ≫ h a := by
    rw [← hq, hc, D.realization.map_add, Functor.map_smul,
      D.realization.map_id, houtgoing]
    change r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) +
      ∑ a : Quiver.Costar x, D.hom a.2 ≫ h a = _
    rfl
  have hsumRadical :
      (∑ a : Quiver.Costar x, D.hom a.2 ≫ h a) ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) := by
    apply (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)).sum_mem
    intro a _
    exact S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.postcomp
      (h a) (D.hom_mem_radical a.2)
  have hscalarRadical : r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) := by
    have hsub := AddSubgroup.sub_mem
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))
      he hsumRadical
    rw [heq] at hsub
    simpa using hsub
  have hr : r = 0 := by
    by_contra hr
    have hradicalAmbient :
        QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism
          (S.projectiveInclusion.map
            (r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))) :=
      (S.fgNilpotentRadicalData.mem_ideal_iff _).1 hscalarRadical
    letI : IsLocalRing (End (S.fgObj x.label)) :=
      S.fgObj_end_isLocalRing x.label
    have hnot : ¬ IsSplitEpi
        (S.projectiveInclusion.map
          (r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))) :=
      (MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.isRadicalMorphism_iff_not_isSplitEpi_of_local_end
        (S.fgObj_indecomposable x.label).1 _).1 hradicalAmbient
    apply hnot
    rw [Functor.map_smul, S.projectiveInclusion.map_id]
    exact MagnitudeConjecture.isSplitEpi_smul_id_of_ne_zero
      (S.fgObj x.label) hr
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, hr, zero_smul, zero_add]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.exists_eq_incoming_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical
statement:
theorem exists_eq_incoming_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical [IsAlgClosed k]
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (x : S.ProjectiveLabel)
    (e : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)
    (he : e ∈ S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)) :
    ∃ h : ∀ a : Quiver.Star x,
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj a.1,
      e = ∑ a : Quiver.Star x, h a ≫ D.hom a.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := D.exists_realization_preimage e
  obtain ⟨r, c, hc⟩ :=
    LinearPathCategory.exists_eq_smul_id_add_incomingSum q
  let h : ∀ a : Quiver.Star x,
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x ⟶ S.ordinaryProjectiveObj a.1 :=
    fun a ↦ D.realization.map (c a)
  have hincoming :
      D.realization.map (LinearPathCategory.incomingSum c) =
        ∑ a : Quiver.Star x, h a ≫ D.hom a.2 := by
    rw [LinearPathCategory.incomingSum, D.realization.map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    dsimp only [h]
    rw [D.realization_map_pathHom]
    change D.realization.map (c a) ≫
        LinearPathCategory.pathMap S.ordinaryProjectiveObj
          (fun {_ _} (b : S.OrdinaryArrow _ _) ↦ D.hom b)
          a.2.toPath =
      D.realization.map (c a) ≫ D.hom a.2
    have ha :
        LinearPathCategory.pathMap S.ordinaryProjectiveObj
            (fun {_ _} (b : S.OrdinaryArrow _ _) ↦ D.hom b)
            a.2.toPath =
          D.hom a.2 :=
      LinearPathCategory.pathMap_toPath S.ordinaryProjectiveObj
        (fun {_ _} (b : S.OrdinaryArrow _ _) ↦ D.hom b) a.2
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ D.realization.map (c a) ≫ f) ha
  have heq : e = r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) +
      ∑ a : Quiver.Star x, h a ≫ D.hom a.2 := by
    rw [← hq, hc, D.realization.map_add, Functor.map_smul,
      D.realization.map_id, hincoming]
    change r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) +
      ∑ a : Quiver.Star x, h a ≫ D.hom a.2 = _
    rfl
  have hsumRadical :
      (∑ a : Quiver.Star x, h a ≫ D.hom a.2) ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) := by
    apply (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)
      (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x)).sum_mem
    intro a _
    exact S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.precomp
      (h a) (D.hom_mem_radical a.2)
  have hscalarRadical : r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) := by
    have hsub := AddSubgroup.sub_mem
      (S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x) (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))
      he hsumRadical
    rw [heq] at hsub
    simpa using hsub
  have hr : r = 0 := by
    by_contra hr
    have hradicalAmbient :
        QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.CategoricalRadical.IsRadicalMorphism
          (S.projectiveInclusion.map
            (r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))) :=
      (S.fgNilpotentRadicalData.mem_ideal_iff _).1 hscalarRadical
    letI : IsLocalRing (End (S.fgObj x.label)) :=
      S.fgObj_end_isLocalRing x.label
    have hnot : ¬ IsSplitEpi
        (S.projectiveInclusion.map
          (r • 𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj x))) :=
      (MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.isRadicalMorphism_iff_not_isSplitEpi_of_local_end
        (S.fgObj_indecomposable x.label).1 _).1 hradicalAmbient
    apply hnot
    rw [Functor.map_smul, S.projectiveInclusion.map_id]
    exact MagnitudeConjecture.isSplitEpi_smul_id_of_ne_zero
      (S.fgObj x.label) hr
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, hr, zero_smul, zero_add]

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.RightKupischComparisonData.kills
statement:
theorem kills
    {D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives}
    {F : D.RightContinuationFork}
    (C : RightKupischComparisonData D F) :
    (D.perturbAt F.changedArrow
      (D.codomainCorrection F.changedArrow C.cornerEndomorphism
        C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).twoStepComposite
          F.killedTwoStep = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrelation :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) ≫
          D.hom F.first := by
    calc
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
          C.connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first :=
        C.firstComparison
      _ = (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) ≫
          D.hom F.first := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, C.secondComparison]
  change
    (D.perturbAt
        ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
        (D.codomainCorrection
          ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).hom
          F.following₂.1.2 ≫
      (D.perturbAt
        ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
        (D.codomainCorrection
          ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).hom
          F.first = 0
  by_cases hfirst :
      (⟨F.startVertex, F.middleVertex, F.first⟩ :
        S.OrdinaryArrowTotal) = F.changedArrow
  · rcases F with
      ⟨start, middle, first, ⟨⟨z₁, b⟩, hb⟩, ⟨⟨z₂, g⟩, hg⟩, hdistinct⟩
    simp only [OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.changedArrow]
      at hfirst hrelation ⊢
    cases hfirst
    have hpost := congrArg
      (fun f ↦ f ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) hrelation
    simp only [Category.assoc] at hpost
    rw [D.perturbAt_hom_self]
    change
      (D.hom first + -(D.hom first ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism)) ≫
        (D.hom first + -(D.hom first ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism)) = 0
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg]
    rw [hrelation]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hpost]
    abel
  · have hfirst' :
        (⟨F.startVertex, F.middleVertex, F.first⟩ :
          S.OrdinaryArrowTotal) ≠
        ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩ := by
      simpa only [OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.changedArrow]
        using hfirst
    rw [D.perturbAt_hom_self,
      D.perturbAt_hom_eq_of_ne
        ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
        (D.codomainCorrection
          ⟨F.middleVertex, F.following₂.1.1, F.following₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)
        F.first hfirst']
    change
      (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 +
          -(D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism)) ≫
        D.hom F.first = 0
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.neg_comp]
    rw [hrelation]
    simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.RightKupischComparisonData.exists_secondPredecessor
statement:
theorem exists_secondPredecessor [IsAlgClosed k]
    {D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives}
    {F : D.RightContinuationFork}
    (C : RightKupischComparisonData D F) :
    ∃ d : Quiver.Costar F.middleVertex,
      F.firstPredecessor ≠ d ∧
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom d.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hzero : ∀ d : Quiver.Costar F.middleVertex,
      F.firstPredecessor ≠ d →
        D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom d.2 = 0 := by
    intro d hd
    by_contra hne
    exact hnone ⟨d, hd, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨h, he⟩ :=
    D.exists_eq_outgoing_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical
      F.middleVertex C.cornerEndomorphism
      C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical
  have hpost :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism =
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫
          D.hom F.firstPredecessor.2) ≫ h F.firstPredecessor := by
    calc
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism =
          ∑ d : Quiver.Costar F.middleVertex,
            (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom d.2) ≫ h d := by
        rw [he, Preadditive.comp_sum]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫
          D.hom F.firstPredecessor.2) ≫ h F.firstPredecessor := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single F.firstPredecessor]
        · intro d _ hd
          rw [hzero d (Ne.symm hd)]
          simp
        · simp
  have hfixed :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) ≫
          D.hom F.first := by
    calc
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
          C.connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first :=
        C.firstComparison
      _ = (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) ≫
          D.hom F.first := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, C.secondComparison]
  let n : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.startVertex ⟶
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.startVertex :=
    h F.firstPredecessor ≫ D.hom F.first
  have hnRadical : n ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.startVertex)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.startVertex) :=
    S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.precomp
      (h F.firstPredecessor) (D.hom_mem_radical F.first)
  have hfixedN :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) ≫ n := by
    calc
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
          (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ C.cornerEndomorphism) ≫
            D.hom F.first := hfixed
      _ = ((D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫
          D.hom F.firstPredecessor.2) ≫ h F.firstPredecessor) ≫
            D.hom F.first := by rw [hpost]
      _ = (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) ≫ n := by
        simp only [n,
          OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.firstPredecessor,
          Category.assoc]
  have hnilpotent :=
    S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.isNilpotent_end_of_mem_ideal hnRadical
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - End.of n) := hnilpotent.isUnit_one_sub
  let u : End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.startVertex) := 1 - End.of n
  letI : IsIso (End.asHom u) :=
    (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso u).mp hunit
  have hcompZero :
      (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) ≫
          End.asHom u = 0 := by
    change
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first -
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) ≫ n = 0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hfixedN
  have hzeroOriginal :
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_mono (End.asHom u)).1
    simpa using hcompZero
  exact F.following₂.2 hzeroOriginal

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.LeftKupischComparisonData.kills
statement:
theorem kills
    {D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives}
    {F : D.LeftContinuationFork}
    (C : LeftKupischComparisonData D F) :
    (D.perturbAt F.changedArrow
      (D.domainCorrection F.changedArrow C.cornerEndomorphism
        C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).twoStepComposite
          F.killedTwoStep = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrelation :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫
          (C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
    calc
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
          D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫
            C.connector := C.firstComparison
      _ = D.hom F.second ≫
          (C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
        rw [C.secondComparison]
  change
    (D.perturbAt
        ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
        (D.domainCorrection
          ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).hom
          F.second ≫
      (D.perturbAt
        ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
        (D.domainCorrection
          ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)).hom
          F.preceding₂.1.2 = 0
  by_cases hsecond :
      (⟨F.middleVertex, F.targetVertex, F.second⟩ :
        S.OrdinaryArrowTotal) = F.changedArrow
  · rcases F with
      ⟨middle, target, second, ⟨⟨z₁, c⟩, hc⟩, ⟨⟨z₂, g⟩, hg⟩, hdistinct⟩
    simp only [OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.changedArrow]
      at hsecond hrelation ⊢
    cases hsecond
    have hpre := congrArg
      (fun f ↦ C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ f) hrelation
    rw [D.perturbAt_hom_self]
    change
      (D.hom g + -(C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom g)) ≫
        (D.hom g + -(C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom g)) = 0
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add,
      Preadditive.neg_comp, Preadditive.comp_neg]
    rw [hrelation]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hpre]
    abel
  · have hsecond' :
        (⟨F.middleVertex, F.targetVertex, F.second⟩ :
          S.OrdinaryArrowTotal) ≠
        ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩ := by
      simpa only [OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.changedArrow]
        using hsecond
    rw [D.perturbAt_hom_self,
      D.perturbAt_hom_eq_of_ne
        ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
        (D.domainCorrection
          ⟨F.preceding₂.1.1, F.middleVertex, F.preceding₂.1.2⟩
          C.cornerEndomorphism C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical)
        F.second hsecond']
    change
      D.hom F.second ≫
        (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 +
          -(C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)) = 0
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_neg]
    rw [hrelation]
    simp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.LeftKupischComparisonData.exists_secondFollowing
statement:
theorem exists_secondFollowing [IsAlgClosed k]
    {D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives}
    {F : D.LeftContinuationFork}
    (C : LeftKupischComparisonData D F) :
    ∃ d : Quiver.Star F.middleVertex,
      F.firstFollowing ≠ d ∧
        D.hom d.2 ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnone
  have hzero : ∀ d : Quiver.Star F.middleVertex,
      F.firstFollowing ≠ d →
        D.hom d.2 ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 = 0 := by
    intro d hd
    by_contra hne
    exact hnone ⟨d, hd, hne⟩
  obtain ⟨h, he⟩ :=
    D.exists_eq_incoming_sum_of_mem_projectiveRadical
      F.middleVertex C.cornerEndomorphism
      C.cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical
  have hpre :
      C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        h F.firstFollowing ≫
          (D.hom F.firstFollowing.2 ≫
            D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
    calc
      C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
          ∑ d : Quiver.Star F.middleVertex,
            h d ≫ (D.hom d.2 ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
        rw [he, Preadditive.sum_comp]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = h F.firstFollowing ≫
          (D.hom F.firstFollowing.2 ≫
            D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single F.firstFollowing]
        · intro d _ hd
          rw [hzero d (Ne.symm hd)]
          simp
        · simp
  have hfixed :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫
          (C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
    calc
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
          D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫
            C.connector := C.firstComparison
      _ = D.hom F.second ≫
          (C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
        rw [C.secondComparison]
  let n : S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex ⟶
      S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex :=
    D.hom F.second ≫ h F.firstFollowing
  have hnRadical : n ∈
      S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex)
        (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex) :=
    S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.postcomp
      (h F.firstFollowing) (D.hom_mem_radical F.second)
  have hfixedN :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        n ≫ (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
    calc
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
          D.hom F.second ≫
            (C.cornerEndomorphism ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) :=
        hfixed
      _ = D.hom F.second ≫
          (h F.firstFollowing ≫
            (D.hom F.firstFollowing.2 ≫
              D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)) := by rw [hpre]
      _ = n ≫
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) := by
        simp only [n,
          OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.firstFollowing,
          Category.assoc]
  have hnilpotent :=
    S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.isNilpotent_end_of_mem_ideal hnRadical
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - End.of n) := hnilpotent.isUnit_one_sub
  let u : End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex) := 1 - End.of n
  letI : IsIso (End.asHom u) :=
    (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso u).mp hunit
  have hcompZero :
      End.asHom u ≫
        (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [u]
    change
      ((𝟙 (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.targetVertex) - n) ≫
          D.hom F.second) ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 = 0
    rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp,
      Preadditive.sub_comp]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hfixedN
  have hzeroOriginal :
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_epi (End.asHom u)).1
    simpa using hcompZero
  exact F.preceding₂.2 hzeroOriginal

statement:

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_rightFork_firstComparison
statement:
theorem exists_rightFork_firstComparison
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (huni : IsUniserialModule Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (RightModule.rightIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first)))) :
    (∃ connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1,
      D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        connector ≫ D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) ∨
    (∃ connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1,
      D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first =
        connector ≫ D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first)
proof:
:= by
  let u₁ := P.compositeInArrowRightIdeal D F.first F.following₁.1.2
  let u₂ := P.compositeInArrowRightIdeal D F.first F.following₂.1.2
  rcases huni.smul_comparable u₁ u₂ with h₁₂ | h₂₁
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₁₂
    let z := P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 * r.unop *
      P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1
    have hzLeft : P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 * z = z := by
      simp only [z, ← mul_assoc, (P.primitive F.following₁.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    have hzRight : z * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 = z := by
      simp only [z, mul_assoc, (P.primitive F.following₂.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    let connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1 :=
      P.projectiveHomOfCoordinate z hzLeft hzRight
    left
    refine ⟨connector, ?_⟩
    apply P.projectiveHomCoordinate_injective
      F.following₂.1.1 F.startVertex
    have hrA := congrArg
      (fun w : RightModule.rightIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first)) ↦ w.1) hr
    change
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) *
          r.unop =
        P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first)
      at hrA
    simp only [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_comp] at hrA ⊢
    rw [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_projectiveHomOfCoordinate]
    let a := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first)
    let b := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
    let g := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₂.1.2)
    change a * g = (a * b) * z
    change (a * b) * r.unop = a * g at hrA
    have hbe : b * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 = b :=
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate_mul_idempotent
        (D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
    have hge : g * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 = g :=
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate_mul_idempotent
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2)
    calc
      a * g = (a * b) * r.unop := hrA.symm
      _ = (a * b) * (P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 * r.unop *
          P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1) := by
        symm
        calc
          (a * b) * (P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 * r.unop *
              P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1) =
              (((a * b) * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1) * r.unop) *
                P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 := by
            simp only [mul_assoc]
          _ = ((a * b) * r.unop) * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 := by
            rw [mul_assoc a b, hbe]
          _ = (a * g) * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 := by rw [hrA]
          _ = a * (g * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1) := by rw [mul_assoc]
          _ = a * g := by rw [hge]
          _ = (a * b) * r.unop := hrA.symm
      _ = (a * b) * z := rfl
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₂₁
    let z := P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 * r.unop *
      P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1
    have hzLeft : P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 * z = z := by
      simp only [z, ← mul_assoc, (P.primitive F.following₂.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    have hzRight : z * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 = z := by
      simp only [z, mul_assoc, (P.primitive F.following₁.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    let connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1 :=
      P.projectiveHomOfCoordinate z hzLeft hzRight
    right
    refine ⟨connector, ?_⟩
    apply P.projectiveHomCoordinate_injective
      F.following₁.1.1 F.startVertex
    have hrA := congrArg
      (fun w : RightModule.rightIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first)) ↦ w.1) hr
    change
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₂.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first) *
          r.unop =
        P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₁.1.2 ≫ D.hom F.first)
      at hrA
    simp only [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_comp] at hrA ⊢
    rw [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_projectiveHomOfCoordinate]
    let a := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first)
    let b := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₂.1.2)
    let g := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
    change a * g = (a * b) * z
    change (a * b) * r.unop = a * g at hrA
    have hbe : b * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 = b :=
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate_mul_idempotent
        (D.hom F.following₂.1.2)
    have hge : g * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 = g :=
      P.projectiveHomCoordinate_mul_idempotent
        (D.hom F.following₁.1.2)
    calc
      a * g = (a * b) * r.unop := hrA.symm
      _ = (a * b) * (P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 * r.unop *
          P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1) := by
        symm
        calc
          (a * b) * (P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1 * r.unop *
              P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1) =
              (((a * b) * P.idempotent F.following₂.1.1) * r.unop) *
                P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 := by
            simp only [mul_assoc]
          _ = ((a * b) * r.unop) * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 := by
            rw [mul_assoc a b, hbe]
          _ = (a * g) * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1 := by rw [hrA]
          _ = a * (g * P.idempotent F.following₁.1.1) := by rw [mul_assoc]
          _ = a * g := by rw [hge]
          _ = (a * b) * r.unop := hrA.symm
      _ = (a * b) * z := rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_rightKupischComparisonChoice
statement:
theorem exists_rightKupischComparisonChoice [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (hprincipal : IsUniserialModule Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (RightModule.rightIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first))))
    (hcorner : ∀ z : S.ProjectiveLabel,
      IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∨
        IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    Nonempty (RightKupischComparisonData D F) ∨
      Nonempty (RightKupischComparisonData D F.swap)
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rightFork_firstComparison D F hprincipal with
      ⟨connector, hfirst⟩ | ⟨connector, hfirst⟩
  · have htarget : F.following₁.1.1 ≠ F.following₂.1.1 :=
      OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.followingTarget_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
        D F hcorner
    have hconnector : connector ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₂.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.following₁.1.1) :=
      S.mem_projectiveRadical_of_ne htarget connector
    obtain ⟨e, he, hsecond⟩ :=
      D.exists_rightFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
        F connector hconnector hfirst (hcorner F.following₂.1.1)
    left
    exact ⟨{
      connector := connector
      connector_mem_radical := hconnector
      firstComparison := hfirst
      cornerEndomorphism := e
      cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical := he
      secondComparison := hsecond }⟩
  · have htarget : F.swap.following₁.1.1 ≠
        F.swap.following₂.1.1 :=
      OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightContinuationFork.followingTarget_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
        D F.swap hcorner
    have hconnector : connector ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.swap.following₂.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.swap.following₁.1.1) :=
      S.mem_projectiveRadical_of_ne htarget connector
    obtain ⟨e, he, hsecond⟩ :=
      D.exists_rightFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
        F.swap connector hconnector hfirst
          (hcorner F.swap.following₂.1.1)
    right
    exact ⟨{
      connector := connector
      connector_mem_radical := hconnector
      firstComparison := hfirst
      cornerEndomorphism := e
      cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical := he
      secondComparison := hsecond }⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_rightSWCorrectionChoice
statement:
theorem exists_rightSWCorrectionChoice [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.RightContinuationFork)
    (hprincipal : IsUniserialModule Aᵐᵒᵖ
      (RightModule.rightIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.first))))
    (hcorner : ∀ z : S.ProjectiveLabel,
      IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex) ∨
        IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex)) :
    OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.RightSWCorrectionChoice D F
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rightKupischComparisonChoice D F hprincipal hcorner with
      hcomparison | hcomparison
  · left
    exact ⟨(Classical.choice hcomparison).toRightSWCorrectionData⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨(Classical.choice hcomparison).toRightSWCorrectionData⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_leftFork_firstComparison
statement:
theorem exists_leftFork_firstComparison
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (huni : IsUniserialModule A
      (RightModule.leftIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second)))) :
    (∃ connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1,
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 ≫ connector) ∨
    (∃ connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1,
      D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2 =
        D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2 ≫ connector)
proof:
:= by
  let u₁ := P.compositeInArrowLeftIdeal D F.preceding₁.1.2 F.second
  let u₂ := P.compositeInArrowLeftIdeal D F.preceding₂.1.2 F.second
  rcases huni.smul_comparable u₁ u₂ with h₁₂ | h₂₁
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₁₂
    let z := P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * r *
      P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1
    have hzLeft : P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * z = z := by
      simp only [z, ← mul_assoc,
        (P.primitive F.preceding₂.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    have hzRight : z * P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 = z := by
      simp only [z, mul_assoc,
        (P.primitive F.preceding₁.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    let connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1 :=
      P.projectiveHomOfCoordinate z hzLeft hzRight
    left
    refine ⟨connector, ?_⟩
    apply P.projectiveHomCoordinate_injective
      F.targetVertex F.preceding₂.1.1
    have hrA := congrArg
      (fun w : RightModule.leftIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second)) ↦ w.1) hr
    change
      r * P.projectiveHomCoordinate
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2) =
        P.projectiveHomCoordinate
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)
      at hrA
    simp only [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_comp] at hrA ⊢
    rw [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_projectiveHomOfCoordinate]
    let a := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second)
    let b := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2)
    let g := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)
    change g * a = z * b * a
    change r * (b * a) = g * a at hrA
    have heb : P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * b = b :=
      P.idempotent_mul_projectiveHomCoordinate
        (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2)
    have heg : P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * g = g :=
      P.idempotent_mul_projectiveHomCoordinate
        (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)
    calc
      g * a = P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * (g * a) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, heg]
      _ = P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * (r * (b * a)) := by
        rw [hrA]
      _ = (P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * r *
          P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1) * b * a := by
        simp only [mul_assoc, heb]
      _ = z * b * a := rfl
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h₂₁
    let z := P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * r *
      P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1
    have hzLeft : P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * z = z := by
      simp only [z, ← mul_assoc,
        (P.primitive F.preceding₁.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    have hzRight : z * P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 = z := by
      simp only [z, mul_assoc,
        (P.primitive F.preceding₂.1.1).idempotent.eq]
    let connector :
        S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1 ⟶
          S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1 :=
      P.projectiveHomOfCoordinate z hzLeft hzRight
    right
    refine ⟨connector, ?_⟩
    apply P.projectiveHomCoordinate_injective
      F.targetVertex F.preceding₁.1.1
    have hrA := congrArg
      (fun w : RightModule.leftIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second)) ↦ w.1) hr
    change
      r * P.projectiveHomCoordinate
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2) =
        P.projectiveHomCoordinate
          (D.hom F.second ≫ D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2)
      at hrA
    simp only [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_comp] at hrA ⊢
    rw [P.projectiveHomCoordinate_projectiveHomOfCoordinate]
    let a := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second)
    let b := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)
    let g := P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2)
    change g * a = z * b * a
    change r * (b * a) = g * a at hrA
    have heb : P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1 * b = b :=
      P.idempotent_mul_projectiveHomCoordinate
        (D.hom F.preceding₂.1.2)
    have heg : P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * g = g :=
      P.idempotent_mul_projectiveHomCoordinate
        (D.hom F.preceding₁.1.2)
    calc
      g * a = P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * (g * a) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, heg]
      _ = P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * (r * (b * a)) := by
        rw [hrA]
      _ = (P.idempotent F.preceding₁.1.1 * r *
          P.idempotent F.preceding₂.1.1) * b * a := by
        simp only [mul_assoc, heb]
      _ = z * b * a := rfl

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_leftKupischComparisonChoice
statement:
theorem exists_leftKupischComparisonChoice [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)
    (D : S.OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives)
    (F : D.LeftContinuationFork)
    (hprincipal : IsUniserialModule A
      (RightModule.leftIdeal
        (P.projectiveHomCoordinate (D.hom F.second))))
    (hcorner : ∀ z : S.ProjectiveLabel,
      IsUniserialModule (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z))
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z) ∨
        IsUniserialModule
          (End (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex))ᵐᵒᵖ
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.middleVertex ⟶
            S.ordinaryProjectiveObj z)) :
    Nonempty (LeftKupischComparisonData D F) ∨
      Nonempty (LeftKupischComparisonData D F.swap)
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_leftFork_firstComparison D F hprincipal with
      ⟨connector, hfirst⟩ | ⟨connector, hfirst⟩
  · have hsource : F.preceding₁.1.1 ≠ F.preceding₂.1.1 :=
      OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.precedingSource_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
        D F hcorner
    have hconnector : connector ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₁.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.preceding₂.1.1) :=
      S.mem_projectiveRadical_of_ne hsource.symm connector
    obtain ⟨e, he, hsecond⟩ :=
      D.exists_leftFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
        F connector hconnector hfirst (hcorner F.preceding₂.1.1)
    left
    exact ⟨{
      connector := connector
      connector_mem_radical := hconnector
      firstComparison := hfirst
      cornerEndomorphism := e
      cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical := he
      secondComparison := hsecond }⟩
  · have hsource : F.swap.preceding₁.1.1 ≠
        F.swap.preceding₂.1.1 :=
      OrdinaryArrowRepresentatives.LeftContinuationFork.precedingSource_ne_of_uniserialAlternative
        D F.swap hcorner
    have hconnector : connector ∈
        S.projectiveNilpotentRadicalData.ideal.hom
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.swap.preceding₁.1.1)
          (S.ordinaryProjectiveObj F.swap.preceding₂.1.1) :=
      S.mem_projectiveRadical_of_ne hsource.symm connector
    obtain ⟨e, he, hsecond⟩ :=
      D.exists_leftFork_secondComparison_of_uniserialAlternative
        F.swap connector hconnector hfirst
          (hcorner F.swap.preceding₂.1.1)
    right
    exact ⟨{
      connector := connector
      connector_mem_radical := hconnector
      firstComparison := hfirst
      cornerEndomorphism := e
      cornerEndomorphism_mem_radical := he
      secondComparison := hsecond }⟩

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation.exists_leftSWCorrectionChoice
statement:
theorem exists_leftSWCorrectionChoice [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : S.PrimitiveProjectivePresentation)

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.standardFormGraded_degreeOne_irreducible
statement:
theorem standardFormGraded_degreeOne_irreducible
    (X Y : S.StandardFormMeshCategory) (t : ℤ)
    (f : (⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj X, t + 1⟩ : Graded.FiniteGradedModule.ShiftedModule) ⟶
      ⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj Y, t⟩) (hf : f ≠ 0) : IsIrreducibleMorphism f
proof:
:= by
  apply MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.irreducible_of_indecomposable_factors
    Graded.FiniteGradedModule.finiteDecomposition f hf
  · intro hs
    letI := hs
    have hr := MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.retraction_ne_zero_of_ne_zero f hf
    have hd := S.standardFormGraded_strict_descent Y X t (t + 1) (retraction f) hr
      (Or.inr (by omega))
    omega
  · intro hs
    letI := hs
    have hr := MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.section_ne_zero_of_ne_zero f hf
    have hd := S.standardFormGraded_strict_descent Y X t (t + 1) (section_ f) hr
      (Or.inr (by omega))
    omega
  · intro M hM a b ha hb
    obtain ⟨i, r, ⟨e⟩⟩ := S.standardFormGraded_shifted_exists_iso M hM
    let Z := MeshCategory.obj (k := k) S.standardFormRightMeshData i
    let a' : (⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj X, t + 1⟩ : Graded.FiniteGradedModule.ShiftedModule) ⟶
        ⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj Z, r⟩ := a ≫ e.hom
    let b' : (⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj Z, r⟩ : Graded.FiniteGradedModule.ShiftedModule) ⟶
        ⟨S.standardFormGradedVertexFunctor.obj Y, t⟩ := e.inv ≫ b
    have ha' : a' ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply ha
      have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ e.inv) hz
      simpa only [a', Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id, zero_comp] using h
    have hb' : b' ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hb
      have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ e.hom ≫ q) hz
      simpa only [b', Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, comp_zero] using h
    by_cases hi : IsIso a'
    · let := hi
      exact Or.inl (IsSplitMono.mk'
        { retraction := e.hom ≫ inv a'
          id := by simpa only [a', Category.assoc] using IsIso.hom_inv_id a' })
    by_cases hj : IsIso b'
    · let := hj
      exact Or.inr (IsSplitEpi.mk'
        { section_ := inv b' ≫ e.inv
          id := by simpa only [b', Category.assoc] using IsIso.inv_hom_id b' })
    have h1 := S.standardFormGraded_noniso_descent X Z (t + 1) r a' ha' hi
    have h2 := S.standardFormGraded_noniso_descent Z Y r t b' hb' hj
    omega

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData.submodule_eq_bot_of_hom_from_boundary_eq_zero
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_bot_of_hom_from_boundary_eq_zero
    (R : S.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData D T)
    (H : S.HasAcyclicNonzeroNonisomorphisms)
    {Y : PosetSpace.Obj k T} {X : S.FactorCategory K}
    (m : Y ⟶ R.representableData.obj X)
    (N : Submodule (S.factorAuslanderRing K)
      ((S.factorAdditiveGenerator K ⟶ X) ⧸
        R.saturatedSubobjectImage H m))
    (hzero : ∀ f :
      (S.factorAdditiveGenerator K ⟶ S.factorProjectiveGenerator K) →ₗ[
        S.factorAuslanderRing K] N,
      f = 0) :
    N = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let e := S.factorBoundaryIdempotent K
  have hann : ∀ z : N, e • z = 0 :=
    (S.factorProjectiveRepresentable_hom_eq_zero_iff K).1 hzero
  have hle : N ≤ IdempotentSaturation.torsionSubmodule
      (M := (S.factorAdditiveGenerator K ⟶ X) ⧸
        R.saturatedSubobjectImage H m) e := by
    apply IdempotentSaturation.le_torsionSubmodule e N
    intro z hz
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hann ⟨z, hz⟩)
  rw [R.torsionSubmodule_saturatedSubobjectAmbientQuotient_eq_bot H m] at hle
  exact le_antisymm hle bot_le

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData.saturatedSubobjectAmbientQuotientNakayamaMap_injective
statement:
theorem saturatedSubobjectAmbientQuotientNakayamaMap_injective
    (R : S.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData D T)
    (H : S.HasAcyclicNonzeroNonisomorphisms)
    {Y : PosetSpace.Obj k T} {X : S.FactorCategory K}
    (m : Y ⟶ R.representableData.obj X) :
    Function.Injective
      (R.saturatedSubobjectAmbientQuotientNakayamaMap H m)
proof:
:= by
  apply RightModule.nakayamaEmbeddingMap_injective (k := k)
  intro N hzero
  apply R.submodule_eq_bot_of_hom_from_boundary_eq_zero H m N
  intro f
  let f' : S.factorBoundaryRepresentableFGObj K ⟶
      FGModuleCat.of (S.factorAuslanderRing K) N :=
    FGModuleCat.ofHom f
  have hf' : f' = 0 := hzero f'
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro p
  have hp := congrArg
    (fun q : S.factorBoundaryRepresentableFGObj K ⟶
        FGModuleCat.of (S.factorAuslanderRing K) N ↦ q.hom.hom p) hf'
  exact hp

name: MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData.saturatedSubobjectImage_projective_of_quotient_projectiveDimensionLE_one
statement:
theorem saturatedSubobjectImage_projective_of_quotient_projectiveDimensionLE_one
    (R : S.PrimitiveProjectivePosetData D T)
    (H : S.HasAcyclicNonzeroNonisomorphisms)
    {Y : PosetSpace.Obj k T} {X : S.FactorCategory K}
    (m : Y ⟶ R.representableData.obj X)
    (hquotient : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (ModuleCat.of (S.factorAuslanderRing K)
        ((S.factorAdditiveGenerator K ⟶ X) ⧸
          R.saturatedSubobjectImage H m)) 1) :

      (ModuleCat.of (S.factorAuslanderRing K)
        (R.saturatedSubobjectImage H m))
proof:
:= by
  let G := S.factorAdditiveGenerator K
  have hRepresentableProjective :
      Projective ((preadditiveCoyonedaObj G).obj X) := by

  apply IdempotentSaturation.saturation_projective_of_quotient_projectiveDimensionLE_one
